overview.zh: 从理解 Web 应用与需求开始，经风险管理和建模，再将设计与架构落实为可工作的应用。每一阶段都要能解释它如何回应用户需要，并用项目资料检查交付物。
overview.en: Start with Web applications and requirements, manage risk and model the system, then realize design and architecture in a working application. At every stage, explain how decisions answer user needs and check deliverables against the project materials.

reason.zh: 先了解目标、考核和全学期路线。
reason.en: Start with outcomes, assessment and the semester route.

reason.zh: 建立 Web 工程、角色和应用类别的基础。
reason.en: Build foundations in Web engineering, roles and app categories.

reason.zh: 把课程方法放入社区信息与反馈项目情境。
reason.en: Place course methods in the community-information/feedback project.

reason.zh: 从利益相关者推导需求，并理解验证、变化和敏捷。
reason.en: Derive stakeholder requirements and understand checking, change and agility.

reason.zh: 用分类与表述练习检查需求分析能力。
reason.en: Check requirements analysis through classification and wording exercises.

reason.zh: 把需求活动按五阶段汇成可追溯的提案。
reason.en: Synthesize requirements through five stages into a traceable proposal.

reason.zh: 识别项目不确定性并制定风险应对。
reason.en: Identify project uncertainty and plan risk responses.

reason.zh: 复习风险过程，并应用到本组项目。
reason.en: Revisit the risk process and apply it to the group project.

reason.zh: 把文字需求转换为用户、内容、交互和配置模型。
reason.en: Translate written needs into user, content, interaction and configuration models.

reason.zh: 用设计目标、质量维度和界面原则检验原型。
reason.en: Evaluate prototypes with design goals, qualities and interface principles.

reason.zh: 此入口是同一设计讲义的重复文件，可选择其一学习。
reason.en: This entry is an identical copy of the design deck; either can be used.

reason.zh: 结合视频画面复习设计原则，并留意教师口述补充。
reason.en: Revisit design through the video and attend to spoken elaboration.

reason.zh: 把功能与质量约束映射为组件、层和请求链。
reason.en: Map functions and quality constraints to components, layers and request flows.

reason.zh: 用基础前端技术和框架理解如何实现界面与行为。
reason.en: Use front-end foundations and frameworks to understand implementation.

reason.zh: 最后按报告和演示评分要求检查成果与制作规则。
reason.en: Finally check artifacts and production rules against the report/demo rubric.

overview.zh: 课程计划把分析能力、应用构建、团队协作和领导力联系起来，并列明考核与学习顺序。这里整理的是课程安排，具体时间及规则仍以老师后续通知为准。
overview.en: The planner connects analysis, application construction, teamwork and leadership with assessments and a learning sequence. This section summarizes the course plan; later lecturer announcements govern schedule or rule changes.

explanation.zh: 课程不仅要求分析需求、模型、设计、架构、测试与版本控制，也要求构建应用、按时组织团队开发并展示领导力。报告、演示和同伴评价分别提供不同能力的证据。
explanation.en: The course requires analysis of requirements, models, design, architecture, testing and version control, plus application construction, timely teamwork and leadership. Reports, simulations and peer evaluation provide evidence of different abilities.

explanation.zh: 总成绩中期末考试占 50%，课程作业占 50%。作业部分由报告 10%、演示 15%、团队与领导力参与 10%、两次测验合计 15% 构成，不能把某项内部原始分当成总评百分比。
explanation.en: The final exam contributes 50% and coursework 50%. Coursework comprises reports 10%, simulations 15%, teamwork and leadership participation 10%, and two tests totaling 15%; raw rubric marks are not overall percentages.

title.zh: 从需求到交付的课程路线

explanation.zh: 课程路线先介绍 Web 工程、需求和项目管理，再学习建模、设计与架构，随后涉及客户端和服务器技术、测试、安全、版本控制及趋势。后续主题是课程计划内容，不代表这些课件已全部发布。
explanation.en: The planned sequence moves from Web engineering, requirements and project management to modelling, design and architecture, then client/server technologies, testing, security, version control and trends. Planned later topics do not imply that their slides have already been released.

title.zh: 分阶段项目与测验安排

explanation.zh: 计划列出第 7 周提交 Part A 报告及演示，第 13 周 Part B 报告，第 15 周 Part B 演示；Test 1 为 2026-11-02、Test 2 为 2026-12-14。学习时应把阶段成果与所需前置知识一起安排。
explanation.en: The planner lists Part A report and simulation in Week 7, Part B report in Week 13 and Part B simulation in Week 15; Test 1 is dated 2026-11-02 and Test 2 2026-12-14. Plan each deliverable together with its prerequisite learning.

explanation.zh: 计划规定出勤少于 70% 可能被禁止参加期末考试，作业应按时提交，缺席测验需有效证明或获准豁免。抄袭及允许他人抄袭均可能导致严重学业后果。
explanation.en: The planner states that attendance below 70% can bar the final exam, assignments must be timely, and missed tests require valid documentation or an approved exemption. Copying and allowing copying can both have serious academic consequences.

title.zh: 生成式 AI 使用声明

explanation.zh: 课程计划要求在适用时说明使用的 AI 工具和提示词，并列入参考资料。各作业可以有更具体的限制，因而应同时查看项目评分要求，不能把一般性署名要求理解成所有用途都获准。
explanation.en: Where applicable, the planner asks students to acknowledge AI tools and prompts in references. Individual assignments may impose more specific restrictions, so check their rubrics rather than treating general acknowledgment as permission for every use.

relation.zh: 能力目标通过不同考核取证
relation.en: Different assessments evidence the learning outcomes

relation.zh: 学习阶段决定交付准备顺序
relation.en: Learning stages determine deliverable preparation

relation.zh: 诚信要求也涵盖工具使用声明
relation.en: Integrity also includes tool-use acknowledgment

prompt.zh: 哪项最完整地体现本课的学习目标？
prompt.en: Which best reflects the full set of course outcomes?

options.zh: 分析概念并写报告即可，应用构建不在目标中
options.en: Analyze concepts and write reports only; construction is outside the outcomes

options.zh: 构建应用即可，团队协作不在目标中
options.en: Build an app only; teamwork is outside the outcomes

options.zh: 展示领导力即可，技术分析无需证据
options.en: Demonstrate leadership only; technical analysis needs no evidence

options.zh: 分析技术、构建应用，并有效协作和领导
options.en: Analyze technologies, build applications, and work and lead effectively

explanation.zh: 学习目标同时包含认知、实践、团队与领导力；单一记忆、报告或个人代做不能覆盖全部目标。
explanation.en: The outcomes include cognitive, practical, teamwork and leadership abilities; memorization, a report alone or one person doing everything does not cover them.

prompt.zh: 按计划，报告、演示、团队参与及两次测验合计占总评多少？
prompt.en: According to the planner, how much of the overall grade comes from reports, simulations, participation and tests?

explanation.zh: 10+15+10+15=50%；另一半来自期末考试，不能把某一部分的占比当成整体。
explanation.en: 10+15+10+15 equals 50%; the other half is the final exam, so a component percentage is not the coursework total.

prompt.zh: 为何应在详细设计之前完成需求分析和建模？
prompt.en: Why should requirements analysis and modelling precede detailed design?

options.zh: 保证需求一经文档化就不会再变化
options.en: Guarantee that documented requirements never change

options.zh: 用模型完全取代之后的测试
options.en: Use models to replace all subsequent testing

options.zh: 先确定实现技术，再让需求适应技术
options.en: Choose implementation technology first and make needs fit it

options.zh: 让设计有可追溯的用户目标和结构依据
options.en: To ground design in traceable user goals and structure

explanation.zh: 课程顺序将需求转为模型，再支撑设计和架构；各阶段解决不同问题，不能彼此替代。
explanation.en: The sequence transforms requirements into models that support design and architecture; the stages solve different problems rather than replace one another.

prompt.zh: 哪种项目计划最符合该课程的分阶段安排？
prompt.en: Which project plan best matches the staged course schedule?

options.zh: 第7周只交报告，所有演示统一留到最后
options.en: Submit only the report in Week 7 and postpone all simulations to the end

options.zh: 先完成全部后台，再回头整理Part A模型
options.en: Finish the entire backend before preparing Part A models

options.zh: 提前完成 Part A 的模型和前端，再推进 Part B
options.en: Prepare Part A models and front end, then progress to Part B

options.zh: 把两个阶段合成一次终期报告以减少重复
options.en: Combine both stages into one final report to avoid repetition

explanation.zh: 计划要求多阶段交付，提前构建各阶段所依赖的成果比最后集中完成更符合安排。
explanation.en: The planner requires staged delivery, so preparing prerequisite artifacts early fits better than postponing everything.

prompt.zh: 按计划，哪种做法最符合学习规范？
prompt.en: Which action best follows the planner rules?

options.zh: 保持出勤、按时提交并独立完成自己的贡献
options.en: Attend, submit on time and complete one’s own contribution

options.zh: 允许其他组复制报告即可免责
options.en: Allow another group to copy the report without consequence

options.zh: 任何理由缺考都自动补考
options.en: Assume every missed test automatically gets a replacement

options.zh: 项目完成后出勤要求便失效
options.en: Assume attendance no longer matters after the project

explanation.zh: 规范同时适用于出勤、按时提交和诚信；提供作业供他人抄袭也在规则范围内。
explanation.en: The rules cover attendance, timely submission and integrity; enabling copying is also covered.

prompt.zh: 已在参考文献写明 AI 工具，是否意味着所有项目用途都获准？
prompt.en: Does naming an AI tool in references mean every project use is permitted?

options.zh: 是，报告中署名就代表演示视频也可用AI替身
options.en: Yes; report acknowledgment permits an AI stand-in in the demo

options.zh: 否，还要满足该交付物的具体限制
options.en: No; the deliverable-specific restrictions still apply

options.zh: 是，只要同组成员同意即可忽略rubric
options.en: Yes; group agreement allows the rubric to be ignored

options.zh: 否，课程计划禁止任何形式的工具致谢
options.en: No; the planner forbids acknowledging tools

explanation.zh: 一般声明要求不覆盖具体作业限制；例如演示视频和直接生成应用的规则需另行遵守。
explanation.en: General acknowledgment does not override specific assignment restrictions; video and direct app-generation rules must be checked separately.

overview.zh: 以槟城 LRT Mutiara Line 施工为情境，把社区信息需求转为利益相关者分析、交互功能和分阶段项目交付。这里帮助理解任务，不提供可直接提交的项目成品。
overview.en: Use the Penang LRT Mutiara Line construction scenario to connect community information needs, stakeholders, interactive functions and staged project delivery. This explains the task rather than supplying a submission-ready project.

title.zh: 项目问题与利益相关者

explanation.zh: 任务围绕道路临时封闭、行人通行、施工日程及商铺出入信息，要求信息及时、可访问且可靠，同时提供提出问题和追踪回应的结构化渠道。发布通知与跟踪反馈是互相补充的需求。
explanation.en: The task concerns temporary road closures, pedestrian access, construction schedules and business access. Information should be timely, accessible and reliable, with a structured way to raise concerns and track responses; notices and feedback tracking complement each other.

title.zh: 多方利益相关者与真实场景

explanation.zh: 潜在用户包括居民、通勤者、当地商家、项目团队和政府部门。需要考虑各方在施工期间遇到的具体情境，而非假设所有人有相同信息与反馈需求。
explanation.en: Potential users include residents, commuters, local businesses, project teams and government bodies. Consider their construction-period scenarios instead of assuming identical information and feedback needs.

explanation.zh: 四人团队需要运用 Web 工程原则分析、设计并开发交互式工作模拟。分析解释需要什么，设计说明如何组织，模拟展示交互确实能工作，三者应相互对应。
explanation.en: A four-person team applies Web engineering principles to analyze, design and develop an interactive working simulation. Analysis explains what is needed, design how it is organized, and simulation that interactions work; the three should align.

title.zh: Part A 与 Part B 的权重
title.en: Part A and Part B weights

explanation.zh: 报告 Part A 和 Part B 各占 5%；模拟 Part A 占 7%、Part B 占 8%。细节由相应老师进一步说明，应把该任务书与具体 rubric 一起使用。
explanation.en: Reports Part A and Part B each contribute 5%; simulations contribute 7% for Part A and 8% for Part B. Lecturers provide the details, so use the brief together with the applicable rubric.

relation.zh: 不同角色的情境确定信息与反馈需求
relation.en: Role-specific scenarios determine information and feedback needs

relation.zh: 需求转成模型、设计和工作流程
relation.en: Needs become models, designs and working flows

relation.zh: 工程成果按阶段提交评价
relation.en: Engineering artifacts are assessed in stages

prompt.zh: 哪个功能组合最直接回应作业情境？
prompt.en: Which feature pair most directly addresses the assignment scenario?

options.zh: 施工团队内部考勤与工资计算
options.en: Internal construction-team attendance and payroll

options.zh: 只显示工程历史背景，不提供施工变更或反馈追踪
options.en: Display only project history without updates or feedback tracking

options.zh: 施工通知与问题回应进度追踪
options.en: Construction notices and concern-response tracking

options.zh: 只收集投诉但不给用户查看回应状态的渠道
options.en: Collect complaints without a way to track responses

explanation.zh: 任务同时强调及时可靠信息与结构化反馈渠道；单纯宣传内容没有形成信息和回应闭环。
explanation.en: The brief emphasizes timely reliable information and structured feedback; promotional content alone does not close the information-response loop.

prompt.zh: 分析商铺入口受施工影响的场景时，最合适的需求来源是什么？
prompt.en: For a scenario where construction affects shop access, which requirement source is most appropriate?

options.zh: 只询问项目管理员并把其意见代表所有群体
options.en: Ask only project administrators and treat their views as representative of all groups

options.zh: 先沿用现有模板的功能，再据此定义用户问题
options.en: Reuse template functions first and derive user problems afterward

options.zh: 只依据开发组对商铺经营的假设
options.en: Rely only on the development team’s assumptions about business operation

options.zh: 商家及相关出入受影响者的实际需求
options.en: Actual needs of businesses and people affected by access changes

explanation.zh: 需求应来自受影响的利益相关者与场景，不能由开发者偏好或单一角色替代。
explanation.en: Requirements should arise from affected stakeholders and scenarios rather than developer preference or one assumed role.

prompt.zh: 仅制作几张无交互的宣传图片，缺少了哪个关键要求？
prompt.en: A few noninteractive promotional images omit which key requirement?

options.zh: 必须将所有可能的政府系统完成后台集成
options.en: Complete backend integration with every possible government system

options.zh: 交互式工作模拟及其工程依据
options.en: An interactive working simulation and its engineering basis

options.zh: 必须先获得真实公众用户再展示原型
options.en: Obtain real public users before demonstrating a prototype

options.zh: 必须用商业模板替代自行设计
options.en: Use a commercial template instead of an original design

explanation.zh: 任务明确要求分析、设计和交互式模拟；宣传图无法单独证明功能流程可工作。
explanation.en: The brief explicitly requires analysis, design and an interactive simulation; promotional images alone cannot show working functional flows.

prompt.zh: 报告与模拟在两个阶段合计占总评多少？
prompt.en: What is the combined overall weighting of reports and simulations across both stages?

explanation.zh: 报告共 10%，模拟共 15%，两类合计 25%；这不是全部课程作业的 50%。
explanation.en: Reports total 10% and simulations 15%, giving 25%; this is not the entire 50% coursework portion.

overview.zh: 把 Part A 报告与演示的评分标准转成学习检查项：内容完整、模型解释准确、前端流程可用以及符合该作业的制作规则。
overview.en: Turn the Part A report and simulation rubric into study checks: complete content, accurate and explained models, working front-end flows and compliance with this assignment’s production rules.

explanation.zh: Part A 报告第 7 周提交，最多 10 页，包含应用介绍、利益相关者、应用类别、模型、原型截图和架构设计。内容完整性比单纯堆积篇幅更符合要求。
explanation.en: The Part A report is due in Week 7 and limited to ten pages. It includes the application introduction, stakeholders, category, models, prototype screenshots and architecture design; completeness within the limit matters more than length.

title.zh: 报告中的功能与引用证据

explanation.zh: 优秀档强调清晰介绍与利益相关者信息，至少 4/5 项主要功能，以及对参考资料和 AI 使用适当致谢。原文使用“4/5”，应按老师说明确认具体数量，规划时可准备五项完整主要功能。
explanation.en: The excellent band emphasizes a clear introduction and stakeholders, at least “4/5” main functions, and appropriate references and AI acknowledgment. The wording “4/5” should be clarified with the lecturer; planning five complete main functions is a practical approach.

title.zh: 相互对应且解释完整的模型

explanation.zh: 优秀模型内容包括用户图、用例图、类图、至少一张准确的序列图和设置正确的架构图，并完整解释图意。图之间应使用一致的角色、功能和对象，解释其如何支持需求。
explanation.en: Excellent modelling includes user, use-case and class diagrams, at least one accurate sequence diagram, a correct architecture diagram and complete explanations. Align roles, functions and objects across the diagrams and explain how they support requirements.

title.zh: Part A 前端可工作范围
title.en: Working front-end scope in Part A

explanation.zh: Part A 展示报告中功能对应的前端页面和可用导航，暂不强制数据操作或连接远程服务器、数据库；Part B 才评价服务器连接。前端范围有限，但按钮和链接仍需正确工作。
explanation.en: Part A demonstrates front-end pages for the reported functions and working navigation. Data manipulation and remote server/database connections are not yet required; server connectivity is assessed in Part B. The limited scope still requires correct buttons and links.

explanation.zh: 演示视频最长 15 分钟，应展示主要工作组件，并包含学生本人的配音和面部画面。该 rubric 明确禁止使用 AI 工具或虚拟形象制作该视频，并写明违规为零分。
explanation.en: The recorded demonstration is limited to fifteen minutes, should show important working components, and must include students’ original voiceover and faces. This rubric explicitly forbids AI tools or avatars for video preparation and states a zero-mark consequence.

title.zh: 应用制作方式的作业限制

explanation.zh: 评分说明表示，直接用 WordPress 等 CMS 或通过 AI 提示生成的 Web 应用会得零分。学习时应理解技术和亲自实现，且向老师确认具体工具边界。
explanation.en: The rubric says Web applications developed directly using a CMS such as WordPress or AI prompts receive zero marks. Learn the underlying techniques, implement your own work and clarify tool boundaries with the lecturer.

title.zh: 设计一致性与导航可靠性

explanation.zh: 演示评价既看主要功能和链接/按钮正确性，也看整站模板一致、颜色主题协调、导航良好。功能与设计是不同评价维度，应分别检查。
explanation.en: Simulation assessment covers core functions and correct links/buttons, as well as consistent templates, coherent colors and good navigation. Function and design are separate dimensions and should be checked independently.

relation.zh: 提案通过模型具体化
relation.en: Models make the proposal concrete

relation.zh: 模型中的功能应在前端体现
relation.en: Modelled functions should appear in the front end

relation.zh: 可运行流程还需一致设计
relation.en: Working flows also need consistent design

relation.zh: 交付形式与制作方式分别受约束
relation.en: Delivery format and creation method have separate constraints

prompt.zh: 哪项组合最符合 Part A 报告范围？
prompt.en: Which set best matches the Part A report scope?

options.zh: 应用介绍和截图完整即可，不必有模型或架构
options.en: A complete introduction and screenshots without models or architecture

options.zh: 所有图型都齐全即可，不必介绍利益相关者
options.en: All diagram types without stakeholder discussion

options.zh: 介绍、用户与类别、模型、原型和架构，且不超十页
options.en: Introduction, stakeholders/category, models, prototype and architecture within ten pages

options.zh: 十五页提案，只要内容完整就符合页数要求
options.en: A complete fifteen-page proposal meets the page limit

explanation.zh: Rubric 要求的是有明确组成的项目提案，并有十页限制；源代码或截图堆积不能代替各项内容。
explanation.en: The rubric asks for a structured proposal within ten pages; source code or a screenshot collection cannot replace the required sections.

prompt.zh: 如何最稳妥地处理 rubric 的“至少 4/5 项功能”措辞？
prompt.en: How should the rubric wording “at least 4/5 functions” be handled?

options.zh: 以任意四个按钮代替四项主要功能
options.en: Treat any four buttons as four main functions

options.zh: 保留该要求并向老师确认，规划完整主要功能
options.en: Retain the requirement, clarify it with the lecturer and plan complete core functions

options.zh: 只提供三项功能也直接按优秀档规划
options.en: Plan only three functions as sufficient for the excellent band

options.zh: 把四到五项功能理解为可选建议，无需核对
options.en: Treat four to five functions as optional advice needing no clarification

explanation.zh: 该表述指主要功能数量但措辞不精确；不应自行变成比例，也不能把细小按钮等同完整功能。
explanation.en: It refers to the number of main functions but is imprecise; it should not become a percentage or a count of individual buttons.

prompt.zh: 哪项最能提高模型部分的完整性？
prompt.en: Which most improves the completeness of the modelling section?

overview.zh: 认识 Web 工程的目的与生命周期，区分开发角色和应用类别，并用网络、质量与内容视角分析 Web 应用。趋势表按课件的教学分类理解。
overview.en: Understand the purpose and lifecycle of Web engineering, distinguish development roles and application categories, and analyze Web apps through network, quality and content concerns. Treat the trends table as the lecture’s teaching classification.

title.zh: 软件与 Web 工程基础

explanation.zh: 软件由定义计算机操作的程序或指令组成。课件先分系统软件与应用软件，再在应用软件下区分 Web 与桌面应用，因此 Web 应用属于软件的一类，而非与软件并列。
explanation.en: Software consists of programs or instructions defining computer operations. The lecture separates system from application software and then Web from desktop applications; a Web app is a kind of software, not a parallel category.

title.zh: 浏览器交付与远程部署

explanation.zh: Web 应用利用网络连接和 Web 标准，通过浏览器或相关界面交付，应用通常部署在远程服务器。需要同时考虑客户端体验与服务端资源。
explanation.en: Web applications use network connections and Web standards and are delivered through a browser or related interface, with the application usually hosted remotely. Both client experience and server resources matter.

title.zh: 系统化的 Web 工程

explanation.zh: Web 工程把软件工程扩展到 Web 应用，用科学、工程和管理原则指导开发、部署与维护。它将零散技术组合成可管理的整体过程，目标是高质量系统。
explanation.en: Web engineering extends software engineering to Web apps, applying scientific, engineering and management principles to development, deployment and maintenance. It organizes separate techniques into a managed process aimed at quality systems.

explanation.zh: 课件生命周期依次包括需求分析、设计、实现、测试与演进。演进意味着上线后的修改与维护仍属于工程范围，而不是发布后就结束。
explanation.en: The lecture lifecycle contains requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing and evolution. Evolution means post-release changes and maintenance remain engineering work rather than ending at publication.

title.zh: 工程目标与项目失败预防

explanation.zh: 工程化旨在控制开发、降低风险并提高质量、可维护性与可扩展性。面对目标偏离、延期、超支和功能缺失，课件提倡明确目标、分阶段开发、认真规划和持续审查；历史统计只用于说明风险。
explanation.en: Engineering aims to control development, reduce risk and improve quality, maintainability and scalability. For missed objectives, delays, overspending and missing functions, the lecture recommends clear goals, phased development, planning and continual audits; historical statistics illustrate the risk.

explanation.zh: 前端关注用户流程、界面、标记代码和跨平台可用性；后端关注业务逻辑、安全代码、数据存储与系统运行。它们围绕同一用户需要协作，而不是各自独立决定需求。
explanation.en: Front-end work focuses on user flows, interfaces, markup and cross-platform usability; back-end work concerns business logic, secure code, storage and system operation. They collaborate around common user needs rather than independently defining requirements.

explanation.zh: Web 工程结合网络工程、信息系统、软件工程和超媒体。分别涉及连接与安全、数据设计与检索、开发生命周期，以及界面结构、导航、可视化、可用性和协作。
explanation.en: Web engineering combines network engineering, information systems, software engineering and hypermedia: connectivity/security, data design/retrieval, the development lifecycle, and interface structure, navigation, visualization, usability and collaboration.

title.zh: 网络、并发、性能与可用性

explanation.zh: 比较 Web 与桌面应用时，要分别看网络依赖、同时访问者、响应表现和服务可访问时间。它们相互影响，但并发人数、响应速度和可用性并不是同一个指标。
explanation.en: When comparing Web and desktop apps, separately examine network dependence, simultaneous users, response behavior and service accessibility over time. These interact, but concurrency, response speed and availability are different measures.

title.zh: 内容、安全、审美与数据驱动
title.en: Content, security, aesthetics and data orientation

explanation.zh: Web 应用比较还包括内容、保护数据与访问的安全性、视觉体验，以及数据对功能的驱动作用。界面好看不能单独证明内容准确、访问安全或数据处理正确。
explanation.en: Other comparison concerns are content, protection of data/access, visual experience, and data-driven behavior. Attractive appearance alone does not establish accurate content, secure access or correct data processing.

title.zh: 文档中心与交互型应用

explanation.zh: 文档中心应用主要提供静态信息，课件例子包括公司页面；交互型应用让用户参与信息选择与响应，如旅行规划。区分重点是用户交互深度，而非页面是否漂亮。
explanation.en: Document-centric apps mainly provide static information, illustrated by company pages; interactive apps let users participate in selecting and responding to information, such as travel planning. The distinction concerns interaction depth rather than appearance.

explanation.zh: 事务型应用支持银行、购物或预订等操作；工作流应用强调按组织流程处理工作，课件以电子政务为例。可从“完成一次事务”与“组织多步骤处理流程”两个角度分析，同一实际站点可能兼具特征。
explanation.en: Transactional apps support banking, shopping or booking operations; workflow-based apps organize work through processes, illustrated by e-government. Analyze transaction completion versus coordinated multistep processing; real sites may combine characteristics.

explanation.zh: 门户把社区或业务信息与服务集中为入口；协作型应用支持多人交流或共同完成内容，课件举 e-learning、聊天室和 Wikipedia。入口整合与共同工作是不同侧重点。
explanation.en: Portals consolidate community or business information and services into an entry point; collaborative apps support communication or shared content work, illustrated by e-learning, chatrooms and Wikipedia. Consolidated access and working together are different emphases.

explanation.zh: 社交 Web 关注用户连接与分享；泛在应用强调位置感知与多平台使用；语义 Web 在课件中连接知识管理与推荐。应按功能特征判断，不把这些类型当成互斥的产品标签。
explanation.en: Social Web emphasizes user connection and sharing; ubiquitous apps emphasize location awareness and multiple platforms; semantic Web is associated here with knowledge management and recommendation. Classify by characteristics rather than assuming mutually exclusive product labels.

title.zh: Web 历史与复杂度视角

explanation.zh: 课件把第一网页与 Tim Berners-Lee、1991 年联系起来，并用历史与复杂度两轴组织应用类别。图用于理解从信息发布到更丰富交互的发展，不表示每种类型都取代此前类型。
explanation.en: The lecture associates the first Web page with Tim Berners-Lee and 1991 and organizes application categories by history and complexity. The diagram illustrates increasingly rich interaction, not the disappearance of earlier categories.

title.zh: Web 1.0、2.0 与 3.0 的课件对比

explanation.zh: 课件把 Web 1.0 概括为静态阅读与信息分享，Web 2.0 为用户生成内容、社交互动和协作，Web 3.0 为情境化、智能化及去中心化方向。这是课件的趋势框架，不保证所有冠以 Web 3.0 的产品都满足其中每项特征。
explanation.en: The lecture summarizes Web 1.0 as static reading/information sharing, Web 2.0 as user-generated content, social interaction and collaboration, and Web 3.0 as contextual, intelligent and decentralized directions. This teaching framework does not guarantee every product labelled Web 3.0 has all those properties.

explanation.en: Evolution covers continued improvement of a delivered application; deployment is not the lifecycle endpoint.

explanation.zh: 目标与持续审查直接处理方向失控；速度、装饰或无限加功能不能替代工程控制。

options.en: An app exclusively transactional merely because checkout exists

options.zh: 只通过知识管理关系组织内容的语义Web
options.en: Semantic Web based solely on knowledge-management relations

explanation.zh: 位置感知和多平台是课件列出的泛在特征；一个实际产品可以同时具有其他类别特征。
explanation.en: Location awareness and multiple platforms are the lecture’s ubiquitous characteristics; a real product may also exhibit other categories.

prompt.zh: 如何正确理解类别图的历史与复杂度坐标？
prompt.en: How should the history/complexity axes in the category diagram be read?

options.zh: 表示越晚出现的网站一定越优质
options.en: Later websites are necessarily better quality

options.zh: 表示所有静态页面已经不存在
options.en: All static pages no longer exist

options.zh: 表示类别之间必须严格互斥
options.en: Categories must be strictly exclusive

options.zh: 说明应用形态的发展，不意味着旧类型全部消失
options.en: They illustrate development without implying older types vanish

explanation.zh: 类别图是教学上的演进视角，不能推出质量排名、旧类别消失或严格互斥。
explanation.en: The diagram offers an educational evolution perspective, not proof of quality ranking, disappearance or strict exclusivity.

prompt.zh: 按课件表格，用户生成内容与社交协作最对应哪个阶段？
prompt.en: In the lecture table, user-generated content and social collaboration align most with which phase?

options.zh: Web 2.0
options.en: Web 2.0

options.zh: Web 1.0的只读信息分享
options.en: Web 1.0 read-only information sharing

options.zh: Web 3.0栏中的去中心化与情境化方向
options.en: Decentralized/contextual directions in the Web 3.0 column

options.zh: 系统软件的底层驱动阶段
options.en: The low-level driver stage of system software

explanation.zh: 课件把动态用户内容与互动协作放在 Web 2.0 列；Web 1.0 侧重只读信息，Web 3.0 则描述另一组趋势。
explanation.en: The table places dynamic user content and collaboration in Web 2.0; Web 1.0 emphasizes read-only information and Web 3.0 another set of trends.

reason.zh: 封面、点名、课堂通知或分组入口，无新增理论内容。
reason.en: Title, attendance, announcements or group-entry instructions add no new theory.

overview.zh: 需求工程建立利益相关者之间的共同理解，把需要变成可检查的规格，并持续处理变化。先区分需求类型，再用 Web 项目的特点理解为什么需要迭代与敏捷。
overview.en: Requirements engineering builds shared stakeholder understanding, turns needs into checkable specifications and manages continuing change. Distinguish requirement types, then use Web-project characteristics to understand iteration and agility.

title.zh: 需求工程的对象与活动

explanation.zh: 需求可以是解决用户问题所需的条件或能力、系统为满足正式约定必须具备的条件，或这些条件的文档表示。秋千图提醒：客户、分析者和开发者的理解可能不同，偏差会造成超支、延期和低接受度。
explanation.en: A requirement may be a condition/capability needed to solve a user problem, a condition a system must meet under a formal agreement, or its documented representation. The swing cartoon warns that customer, analyst and developer interpretations can diverge, causing overruns, delays and poor acceptance.

explanation.zh: Web 需求可能涉及服务器和开发设备、多平台、网络协议与安全、设计复杂度与一致性以及信息/交互/事务功能。需求不应被缩减为页面上的功能按钮。
explanation.en: Web requirements may address servers and development hardware, multiple platforms, network protocols/security, design complexity/consistency, and information, interaction or transaction functions. They are broader than buttons on a page.

explanation.zh: 利益相关者是直接或间接影响应用需求的人或组织，可能包括用户、客户、所有者、管理者、政府及财务角色。识别时要看影响和需要，不只看谁实际点击网页。
explanation.en: Stakeholders are people or organizations directly or indirectly influencing application requirements, including users, customers, owners, managers, government and financial roles. Identify influence and needs, not merely who clicks the pages.

explanation.zh: 需求工程以获取、理解、规定和确认需要为过程。获取与协商通过利益相关者沟通、学习和共识形成，把不同专业观点整合为各方可接受的解决方案。
explanation.en: Requirements engineering elicits, understands, specifies and validates needs. Elicitation and negotiation use stakeholder communication, learning and consensus-building to combine expertise into a mutually acceptable solution.

explanation.zh: 将已经达成的共识细化为明确、详细的需求文档，使设计、验证和后续变更有共同依据。文档化不能只留下会议口号或未经同意的个人想法。
explanation.en: Refine agreed stakeholder consensus into explicit, detailed requirements documents so design, checking and later change share a reference. Documentation is more than meeting slogans or one person’s unapproved ideas.

explanation.zh: 确认（validation）问“规定的是不是正确的需要”，检验是否符合用户目的；验证（verification）问“规格是否被正确地写出”，检查表述的正确性。两者分别关注对象是否正确和表达是否正确。
explanation.en: Validation asks whether the right needs have been specified, checking user purpose. Verification asks whether the specification was written correctly. They distinguish the right target from a correct expression of it.

explanation.zh: Web 项目的需求和约束经常变化，需要方法和工具整合新需求并调整已有需求。管理贯穿开发，不能把首次文档完成当作需求工作的终点。
explanation.en: Web requirements and constraints change frequently, requiring methods and tools to integrate new requirements and revise existing ones. Management continues through development rather than ending with the first document.

explanation.zh: Web 团队包括内容作者、媒体、架构、数据库和可用性等专家；实际利益相关者可能无法参与，需要合适代表提供真实使用情境。代表的任务是带来需求证据，而不是代替所有用户想当然。
explanation.en: Web teams involve content, media, architecture, database and usability expertise. When stakeholders are unavailable, suitable representatives should provide realistic use contexts. Representatives supply need evidence rather than speculate on behalf of all users.

title.zh: 变化中的约束与运行环境

explanation.zh: Web 项目需求难以长期稳定，且运行环境不可预测，例如带宽改变会影响响应时间。需求应说明适用条件，并持续关注变化，而不是假设开发机环境等于所有用户环境。
explanation.en: Web requirements rarely stay stable, and operating environments are unpredictable: bandwidth changes can affect response time. State relevant conditions and monitor change rather than equating the developer’s machine with every user environment.

explanation.zh: 既有系统和预算会限制可选方案，开发者对新工具和标准的经验不足会增加不确定性，而固定交付日期形成按期设计的压力。规划应显式考虑这些约束，不能只考虑理想技术方案。
explanation.en: Existing systems and budgets constrain solutions, inexperienced developers face uncertainty with tools and standards, and firm dates create design-to-schedule pressure. Planning should make these constraints explicit rather than assume an ideal technical solution.

title.zh: 质量、界面和内容的特殊关注
title.en: Special attention to quality, interface and content

explanation.zh: Web 需求强调性能、安全、可用性等质量，也重视界面和内容质量。用户可能看到原型后才明确想法，因此可以用原型帮助澄清；内容应兼顾准确、可信、相关、及时、完整与清晰。
explanation.en: Web requirements emphasize qualities such as performance, security and usability as well as interface and content quality. Users may clarify preferences only after seeing a prototype. Content needs accuracy, credibility, relevance, currency, completeness and clarity.

explanation.zh: 功能需求说明系统能做什么，例如账户间转账；非功能需求说明能力的性质或约束，例如可支持多少并发用户。二者需要配合：一个描述行为，一个规定行为应具备的质量或条件。
explanation.en: Functional requirements state what the system does, such as transferring money between accounts. Non-functional requirements describe properties or constraints, such as concurrent-user capacity. One defines behavior; the other qualifies its quality or conditions.

explanation.zh: 课件的质量分类中，功能性关注满足指定属性的功能是否存在；可靠性关注在指定条件与期间维持性能。此处“功能性质量”是质量模型术语，应与“具体功能需求”区分层次。
explanation.en: In the lecture quality classification, functionality concerns the presence of functions meeting specified properties; reliability concerns maintaining performance under given conditions over time. “Functionality” as a quality-model term is a different level from an individual functional requirement.

explanation.zh: 可用性关注人能否有效理解和使用系统；效率在课件中是性能水平相对于所用资源的关系。更容易操作和更节省计算资源是不同改善方向。
explanation.en: Usability concerns how effectively people understand and use the system. Efficiency is the relationship between performance and consumed resources. Easier operation and more economical computation are different improvements.

explanation.zh: 可维护性关注实现预定修改所需的努力；可移植性关注把软件从一个环境移到另一个环境的适合程度，包括适应、安装、符合要求和替换能力。易于改功能不等于易于换运行环境。
explanation.en: Maintainability concerns effort to implement planned changes. Portability concerns moving software between environments, including adaptability, installability, conformance and replaceability. Easy feature modification is not the same as easy environment migration.

explanation.zh: 内容需求规定应用提供哪些信息；系统环境需求描述应用如何嵌入目标环境及与外部组件交互。它们分别回答“提供什么内容”和“与什么环境协同”。
explanation.en: Content requirements specify information supplied by the app. System-environment requirements describe how it fits into the target environment and interacts with external components. They answer what content is supplied and what environment it works with.

title.zh: 用户界面与以使用为中心的设计

explanation.zh: 界面需求强调易于理解、直觉性以及围绕实际使用任务组织设计。应说明用户怎样完成任务，而不仅给出开发者个人偏好的视觉风格。
explanation.en: Interface requirements emphasize self-explanation, intuitiveness and organization around actual tasks. Describe how users complete work rather than merely a developer’s preferred visual style.

explanation.zh: 需求可以预先说明未来增强，例如两年后增加五千名并发用户。它让当前设计考虑合理扩展方向，但不意味着必须立即实现所有未来功能。
explanation.en: Requirements may state future enhancements, such as five thousand additional concurrent users in two years. They let current design consider extension without demanding immediate implementation of every future feature.

explanation.zh: 预算、进度、技术限制、标准、部署规则、维护和运营条件以及法律文化因素都可能约束项目。约束说明方案必须满足的边界，不能仅用功能列表替代。
explanation.en: Budget, schedule, technical limits, standards, deployment rules, maintenance/operation conditions and legal/cultural factors can constrain a project. Constraints define solution boundaries beyond a feature list.

title.zh: 敏捷的动机与工作方式
title.en: Motivation and working style of agility

explanation.zh: 业务规则、管理要求和利益相关者想法变化很快，敏捷以客户满意、早期增量交付、小团队、简单工作产物和持续沟通应对不确定性。强调交付并不表示可以忽略质量或需求。
explanation.en: Rapid changes in business rules, management demands and stakeholder views motivate agility: customer satisfaction, early incremental delivery, small teams, simple work products and continuous communication. Emphasizing delivery does not remove quality or requirements work.

title.zh: 早交付、欢迎变化与短周期
title.en: Early delivery, welcomed change and short cycles

explanation.zh: 课件原则强调尽早且持续交付有价值的软件，欢迎后期变化，并以较短周期频繁交付可工作的增量。重点是可用价值和反馈，不是不断提交未完成页面。
explanation.en: The principles emphasize early continuous delivery of valuable software, welcome even late changes, and favor frequent working increments on shorter timescales. The focus is usable value and feedback, not repeatedly handing over unfinished pages.

explanation.zh: 业务人员与开发者应持续合作，围绕有动力的人组织项目并提供支持与信任；课件强调面对面沟通的效率。核心是缩短理解与反馈距离，而非让团队独自猜测业务。
explanation.en: Business people and developers should collaborate continuously, with motivated people receiving support and trust. The lecture emphasizes efficient face-to-face communication; the core is shortening the distance between understanding and feedback.

title.zh: 可持续节奏、技术卓越与反思
title.en: Sustainable pace, technical excellence and reflection

explanation.zh: 可工作软件是进展的主要度量；团队应维持可持续节奏、重视良好设计和技术质量，由自组织团队形成方案，并定期反思调整。敏捷包含工程纪律，不等于长期加班或随意拼凑。
explanation.en: Working software is the main progress measure. Teams should sustain a steady pace, maintain good design and technical quality, self-organize solutions, and regularly reflect and adjust. Agility includes engineering discipline, not perpetual overtime or improvised patchwork.

relation.zh: 需要来自能够影响系统的各方
relation.en: Needs arise from parties influencing the system

relation.zh: 沟通利益相关者以获取和协商需要
relation.en: Communicate with stakeholders to elicit and negotiate

relation.zh: 把共识细化成书面规格
relation.en: Refine consensus into written specifications

relation.zh: 检查规格的目标与表达
relation.en: Check both specification target and expression

relation.zh: 经检查的规格仍须持续管理
relation.en: Checked specifications still need continuous management

relation.zh: 变化和不确定性推动敏捷工作
relation.en: Change and uncertainty motivate agility

relation.zh: 具体行为与质量维度共同约束系统
relation.en: Concrete behavior and quality dimensions jointly constrain the system

relation.zh: 易维护和可移植的结构支持未来演进
relation.en: Maintainable and portable structures support future evolution

relation.zh: 敏捷通过有价值的增量落地
relation.en: Agility is realized through valuable increments

relation.zh: 持续协作由节奏和反思支撑
relation.en: Continuous collaboration is supported by pace and reflection

prompt.zh: 团队按字面完成了功能，用户却说“不是我要的”，首先应检查什么？
prompt.en: The team built the literal functions, but users say “not what I wanted.” What should be checked first?

options.zh: 把编码速度作为唯一问题并立即扩大开发团队
options.en: Treat coding speed as the sole issue and expand the team immediately

options.zh: 只确认文档语法没有错误就结束检查
options.en: Stop once document syntax is confirmed correct

options.zh: 在未核对用户目的前直接增加功能数量
options.en: Add functions before checking user purpose

options.zh: 各方对用户需要与需求表述是否有共同理解
options.en: Whether stakeholders share an understanding of user needs and their specification

explanation.zh: 需求是对真实需要的表达，解释偏差会贯穿开发；完成某种实现不等于满足用户问题。
explanation.en: Requirements represent real needs, and interpretation errors propagate; producing an implementation does not prove the user’s problem is solved.

prompt.zh: 哪组内容都属于课件提示应考虑的 Web 需求范围？
prompt.en: Which set lies within the lecture’s Web-requirements scope?

options.zh: 只有功能清单，质量与环境都等实现后再考虑
options.en: Only features, with quality/environment deferred until implementation

options.zh: 功能、设计、网络安全与硬件环境
options.en: Functionality, design, network security and hardware environment

options.zh: 只有服务器配置，用户功能不属于需求
options.en: Only server configuration; user functions are not requirements

options.zh: 只有界面原型，网络与安全无需记录
options.en: Only interface prototypes; network/security need no record

explanation.zh: 课件明确从硬件、网络、设计和功能四方面展开；需求分析必须考虑相关环境和约束。
explanation.en: The lecture explicitly covers hardware, network, design and function, including relevant environment and constraints.

prompt.zh: 某监管部门不登录系统，但规定必须保留哪些记录，它是否是利益相关者？
prompt.en: A regulator never logs in but defines required record retention. Is it a stakeholder?

options.zh: 否，只有登录者才算
options.en: No; only people who log in count

options.zh: 否，只有软件开发者才算
options.en: No; only developers count

options.zh: 是，因为它间接影响需求
options.en: Yes, because it indirectly influences requirements

options.zh: 只有它拥有服务器时才算
options.en: Only if it owns the server

explanation.zh: 定义包含间接影响，监管要求可约束系统；登录行为不是必要条件。
explanation.en: The definition includes indirect influence: regulatory constraints affect the system without requiring login.

prompt.zh: 两个利益相关者提出相冲突的需求，最符合获取与协商的是？
prompt.en: Two stakeholders request conflicting requirements. Which response fits elicitation and negotiation?

options.zh: 由开发者单方面选择实现最容易的一项
options.en: Let developers choose only the easiest option unilaterally

options.zh: 把两个矛盾要求都原样写进最终规格
options.en: Copy both conflicting requests unchanged into the final specification

options.zh: 先实施两个版本，再在交付时才让用户选择
options.en: Implement both versions and postpone the choice until delivery

options.zh: 沟通目标和约束，寻求双方可接受的方案
options.en: Discuss goals and constraints to reach a mutually acceptable solution

explanation.zh: 协商是共享专业知识并建立共识的过程，不能由随机或时间先后替代。
explanation.en: Negotiation shares expertise and builds consensus; randomness or message order is no substitute.

prompt.zh: 一次需求会议已达成共识，下一步最合适的成果是什么？
prompt.en: A requirements meeting reaches consensus. What is the most suitable next artifact?

options.zh: 只保存会议主题，不细化同意的条件
options.en: Keep only the meeting topic without refining agreed conditions

options.zh: 详细描述已同意条件的需求文档
options.en: A requirements document detailing the agreed conditions

options.zh: 马上创建最终代码并把代码当作唯一需求记录
options.en: Create final code and use it as the sole requirements record

options.zh: 把未讨论的新功能加入文档并视为已有共识
options.en: Add undiscussed functions and treat them as agreed

explanation.zh: 文档化把共识转成可使用、可检查的规格；它不是取消以后管理变更。
explanation.en: Documentation converts consensus into usable, checkable specifications; it does not eliminate later change management.

prompt.zh: 规格语法和一致性都正确，但解决了用户不需要的问题，主要是哪项不足？
prompt.en: A specification is syntactically consistent but solves an unwanted problem. Which activity was mainly inadequate?

options.zh: 需求确认 Validation
options.en: Requirements validation

options.zh: 规格验证Verification，关注是否正确写出规格
options.en: Specification verification, focused on whether the specification is written correctly

options.zh: 需求文档格式统一，关注模板排版
options.en: Document-format standardization, focused on template layout

options.zh: 仅用代码测试替代与用户核对目标
options.en: Code testing alone instead of checking goals with users

explanation.zh: “正确地规定”不能保证“规定了正确的事”；该场景的缺口是用户需要的确认。
explanation.en: Specifying something correctly does not ensure it is the right thing; the gap is validation of user needs.

prompt.zh: 系统开发中新增一个经过同意的需求，应该如何处理？
prompt.en: A newly agreed requirement appears during development. What should happen?

options.zh: 只私下改代码而不更新规格
options.en: Change code privately without updating specifications

options.zh: 因为有初版文档所以永远拒绝
options.en: Always reject it because an initial document exists

options.zh: 纳入需求管理并协调已有需求的调整
options.en: Integrate it through requirements management and coordinate existing requirements

options.zh: 同时保留互相矛盾的规格
options.en: Keep contradictory specifications unchanged

explanation.zh: 变化需要被有序整合；忽略文档、永远拒绝或保留矛盾都不符合持续管理。
explanation.en: Change needs orderly integration; bypassing documents, permanent rejection or retaining contradictions undermines management.

prompt.zh: 面向大量公众的站点无法访谈每名用户，较合适的做法是？
prompt.en: A public site cannot interview every user. What is a suitable response?

options.zh: 只从开发团队抽一个人代表所有用户
options.en: Choose one developer to represent all users

options.zh: 只记录最容易实现的需求，等待投诉补全
options.en: Record only easy requirements and fill gaps from later complaints

options.zh: 选择能代表真实使用情境的用户代表并结合多领域意见
options.en: Choose representatives of real use contexts and combine multidisciplinary input

options.zh: 直接沿用旧系统需求，假设公众需要没有差异
options.en: Reuse old requirements and assume no differences in public needs

explanation.zh: 课件将利益相关者难以直接参与和多学科协作列为特点；代表性输入比单一专家猜测更合适。
explanation.en: The lecture highlights unavailable stakeholders and multidisciplinary work; representative input is better than one expert guessing.

prompt.zh: 应用在开发机很快而在低带宽环境很慢，体现哪个 Web 需求特点？
prompt.en: An app is fast on the development machine but slow on low bandwidth. Which Web requirement characteristic is illustrated?

options.zh: 只说明开发人员对语言语法不熟悉
options.en: It only shows unfamiliarity with programming-language syntax

options.zh: 运行环境不可预测，需要考虑环境条件
options.en: Unpredictable operating environments require explicit conditions

options.zh: 说明所有用户界面原型都无效
options.en: It shows that all interface prototypes are useless

options.zh: 说明需求一经批准就与环境无关
options.en: It shows approved requirements are independent of environment

explanation.zh: 带宽是课件给出的环境变量，性能需要在相关条件下理解和验证。
explanation.en: Bandwidth is the lecture’s example environment variable; performance must be understood and checked under relevant conditions.

prompt.zh: 已有系统不能替换且交付日期固定，需求分析应怎样做？
prompt.en: The existing system cannot be replaced and delivery is fixed. What should requirements analysis do?

options.zh: 把集成、能力与时间约束纳入可行范围
options.en: Include integration, capability and time constraints in feasible scope

options.zh: 先按理想环境设计，等测试时才考虑集成限制
options.en: Design for an ideal environment and consider integration limits only during tests

options.zh: 只记录功能，把日期和平台当成无关管理信息
options.en: Record functions only and treat dates/platforms as unrelated administration

options.zh: 为保留范围而假定团队经验不会影响进度
options.en: Assume team experience cannot affect schedule to preserve scope

explanation.zh: 遗留集成、人员经验和期限影响可行性，应在需求与范围选择中考虑。
explanation.en: Legacy integration, experience and deadlines affect feasibility and therefore requirements and scope choices.

prompt.zh: 用户说“看到才知道想要什么”，最有帮助的需求活动是？
prompt.en: A user says “I will know what I want when I see it.” Which activity helps most?

options.zh: 展示原型并讨论界面与内容
options.en: Show a prototype and discuss interface and content

options.zh: 只让用户签署抽象文字规格并停止反馈
options.en: Have users sign abstract wording and stop feedback

options.zh: 等最终系统全部完成后再展示界面
options.en: Wait until the entire final system is finished before showing the interface

options.zh: 先定硬件规格并把它当成界面验收依据
options.en: Set hardware specifications and use them as interface acceptance evidence

explanation.zh: 原型把抽象界面想法变成可讨论的实例，用户可据此反馈；只签署文字、等最终交付或先定硬件都不能及时检验这种体验。
explanation.en: A prototype turns abstract interface ideas into examples users can discuss. Signing text, waiting for final delivery or fixing hardware first does not promptly validate that experience.

prompt.zh: “允许转账”与“支持一千名并发用户”分别属于？
prompt.en: How should “allow transfers” and “support one thousand concurrent users” be classified?

options.zh: 非功能；功能
options.en: Non-functional; functional

options.zh: 两项都是具体业务功能
options.en: Both are concrete business functions

options.zh: 两项都是运行质量，不涉及业务行为
options.en: Both are runtime qualities without business behavior

options.zh: 功能；非功能
options.en: Functional; non-functional

explanation.zh: 转账是提供的行为，并发容量是行为运行的性质；两者不能按是否含数字以外的表面词判断。
explanation.en: Transfer is offered behavior; concurrent capacity is an operating property, not another user function.

prompt.zh: 系统具有所需功能，却常在持续运行中失效，主要缺少哪种质量？
prompt.en: The system has the required functions but often fails during sustained operation. Which quality is mainly weak?

options.zh: 可移植性，关注迁移到其他环境
options.en: Portability, concerning migration to other environments

options.zh: 可维护性，关注修改功能的努力
options.en: Maintainability, concerning effort to change functions

options.zh: 功能性，关注功能是否存在而非持续稳定
options.en: Functionality, concerning function presence rather than sustained stability

options.zh: 可靠性
options.en: Reliability

explanation.zh: 功能存在不保证持续保持性能；持续运行中的稳定性属于可靠性。
explanation.en: Function presence does not guarantee maintained performance; sustained dependable operation concerns reliability.

prompt.zh: 相同工作负载下减少内存消耗且保持性能，最直接改善什么？
prompt.en: Reducing memory consumption while preserving performance under the same workload most directly improves what?

options.zh: 可用性，减少用户理解界面的难度
options.en: Usability, reducing difficulty understanding the interface

options.zh: 可移植性，减少跨环境安装困难
options.en: Portability, reducing cross-environment installation difficulties

options.zh: 可维护性，减少修改代码的努力
options.en: Maintainability, reducing effort to modify code

options.zh: 效率
options.en: Efficiency

explanation.zh: 效率比较性能和资源；菜单理解偏向可用性，跨环境部署偏向可移植性。
explanation.en: Efficiency relates performance to resources; menu understanding concerns usability and cross-environment deployment portability.

prompt.zh: 将应用从一种运行环境迁到另一种时遇到大量安装问题，最直接涉及什么？
prompt.en: Many installation problems occur when moving an app to another environment. Which quality is most directly involved?

options.zh: 效率，关注性能与资源的比值
options.en: Efficiency, concerning performance relative to resources

options.zh: 可靠性，关注原环境持续运行的表现
options.en: Reliability, concerning sustained operation in the original environment

options.zh: 功能性，关注所需业务功能是否存在
options.en: Functionality, concerning required function presence

options.zh: 可移植性
options.en: Portability

explanation.zh: 跨环境适应和安装属于可移植性；功能修改努力才更接近可维护性。
explanation.en: Adaptation and installation across environments concern portability; feature-change effort concerns maintainability.

prompt.zh: “显示施工公告”中的信息范围与“连接现有交通信息服务”中的环境关系应分别考察什么？
prompt.en: What should be examined for the information scope of “show construction notices” and the environment relation of “connect an existing transport service”?

options.zh: 用户界面风格；功能执行顺序
options.en: User-interface style; functional execution order

options.zh: 内容需求；系统环境需求
options.en: Content requirements; system-environment requirements

options.zh: 项目预算；演进期限
options.en: Project budget; evolution deadline

options.zh: 系统环境需求；内容需求
options.en: System-environment requirements; content requirements

explanation.zh: 内容与外部集成是不同需求面；二者共同约束后续设计。
explanation.en: Content and external integration are distinct requirement dimensions that jointly constrain design.

prompt.zh: 哪项更符合以使用为中心的界面需求？
prompt.en: Which better fits a usage-centered interface requirement?

options.zh: 用开发者实现最方便的流程要求用户适应
options.en: Make users adapt to the easiest flow for developers to implement

options.zh: 先确定视觉风格，不再检验是否支持用户任务
options.en: Fix visual style without checking task support

options.zh: 让访客能理解并完成查询路线的步骤
options.en: Enable visitors to understand and complete route-query steps

options.zh: 仅统计页面数量作为易用性的验收
options.en: Use page count alone as usability acceptance

explanation.zh: 界面应服务实际任务并帮助理解；个人风格和无关装饰不是使用目标。
explanation.en: The interface should support real tasks and understanding; personal style or unrelated decoration is not a usage goal.

prompt.zh: “两年后要承载更多并发用户”应如何用于当前设计？
prompt.en: How should “support more concurrent users in two years” influence current design?

options.zh: 把未来目标直接当成今天必须全部交付的功能
options.en: Treat the future target as functionality that must all ship today

options.zh: 作为演进需求考虑扩展能力
options.en: Consider extensibility as an evolution requirement

options.zh: 只考虑当前容量，未来需求一律不影响架构
options.en: Consider only current capacity and exclude future needs from architecture

options.zh: 把扩展能力交给用户操作说明解决
options.en: Solve capacity growth solely through user instructions

explanation.zh: 未来能力要求提供演进方向，可影响架构和容量选择；它不等于即时实现清单。
explanation.en: Future capability requirements guide evolution and may affect architecture/capacity choices; they are not automatically immediate features.

prompt.zh: 只能使用现有服务器并在固定日期交付，属于哪种需求信息？
prompt.en: Using only existing servers and delivering by a fixed date are what kind of requirement information?

options.zh: 功能需求，规定用户必须执行的业务动作
options.en: A functional requirement specifying a user business action

options.zh: 项目约束
options.en: Project constraints

options.zh: 内容需求，规定页面应显示的信息对象
options.en: A content requirement specifying displayed information objects

options.zh: 演进需求，单纯描述未来增强目标
options.en: An evolution requirement describing only future enhancements

explanation.zh: 技术资源和日期限定可行方案，是项目约束而非用户操作或内容本身。
explanation.en: Technical resources and dates bound feasible solutions, so they are constraints rather than user actions or content.

prompt.zh: 为何变化频繁的 Web 项目适合采用增量交付？
prompt.en: Why is incremental delivery useful for a frequently changing Web project?

options.zh: 尽早交付价值并通过反馈调整后续工作
options.en: Deliver value early and use feedback to adjust subsequent work

options.zh: 保证需求从此不再变化
options.en: Guarantee requirements never change again

options.zh: 允许完全不与客户沟通
options.en: Allow no communication with customers

options.zh: 保证可以跳过设计质量
options.en: Guarantee design quality can be skipped

explanation.zh: 增量和沟通帮助应对不确定性，而不是消除变化或免除质量责任。
explanation.en: Increments and communication help manage uncertainty rather than eliminate change or quality responsibilities.

prompt.zh: 哪种交付最符合敏捷原则？
prompt.en: Which delivery best fits the agile principles?

options.zh: 每天交付无法运行的截图合集
options.en: Deliver nonworking screenshot collections daily

options.zh: 频繁交付可工作的有价值增量并接受反馈
options.en: Frequently deliver valuable working increments and accept feedback

options.zh: 最终一次交付之前拒绝一切交流
options.en: Reject all communication until one final release

options.zh: 所有变化都自动当成失败
options.en: Treat every change as failure

explanation.zh: 频率需要与可工作和价值结合，才支持用户反馈与持续调整。
explanation.en: Frequency must be combined with working value to support feedback and adaptation.

prompt.zh: 业务规则有歧义时，最符合这些原则的处理是？
prompt.en: Business rules are ambiguous. Which response best fits these principles?

options.zh: 让业务与开发人员直接讨论并澄清
options.en: Have business and development participants discuss and clarify directly

options.zh: 禁止业务人员参与直到项目结束
options.en: Ban business participation until project completion

options.zh: 只让开发者自行猜测
options.en: Let developers guess alone

options.zh: 用更多无人阅读的文件代替交流
options.en: Replace dialogue with more unread documents

explanation.zh: 持续协作与直接沟通用于减少理解偏差；堆积文件或隔离业务会延长反馈链。
explanation.en: Collaboration and direct communication reduce interpretation errors; document piles or business isolation lengthen feedback loops.

prompt.zh: 哪个团队行为最符合课件的后半组敏捷原则？
prompt.en: Which team behavior best fits the latter agile principles in the lecture?

options.zh: 只用加班时长衡量进展
options.en: Measure progress only by overtime hours

options.zh: 为追速度长期放弃设计质量
options.en: Abandon design quality indefinitely for speed

options.zh: 项目结束前从不反思
options.en: Never reflect before project completion

options.zh: 用工作软件衡量进展，保持可持续节奏并定期改进
options.en: Measure working software, sustain pace and improve regularly

explanation.zh: 工作成果、可持续开发、技术卓越和反思互相支持；加班或放弃设计并不是敏捷指标。
explanation.en: Working outcomes, sustainable development, excellence and reflection reinforce one another; overtime and neglected design are not agility measures.

reason.zh: 章节封面与结束页。
reason.en: Section title and closing slide.

overview.zh: 用需求分类和表述质量练习检验理解：区分系统行为、质量属性与约束，再检查条件是否具体且可验证。示例是学习解析，应结合课堂讨论理解。
overview.en: Use classification and wording exercises to test understanding: distinguish behavior, qualities and constraints, then check specificity and verifiability. These are learning explanations to use alongside class discussion.

title.zh: 把需求分类用于实际表述

explanation.zh: 注册账户、加入购物车、生成月报、订单确认后发通知以及停用账户，都描述系统提供的行为，因此是功能需求。是否提到管理员或时间周期，不会自动把行为变成非功能需求。
explanation.en: Account registration, adding to cart, generating monthly reports, sending order-confirmation notifications and deactivating accounts describe system behavior and are functional requirements. Mentioning an administrator or a monthly cycle does not automatically make behavior non-functional.

title.zh: 性能、容量与可用性分类

explanation.zh: 两秒内加载首页属于响应性能；支持五千并发用户属于容量性质；每月 99.9% 可用属于服务可用性。这些是对系统行为的质量要求，指标不同，测试方法也应相应区分。
explanation.en: Loading within two seconds concerns response performance, five thousand concurrent users concerns capacity, and 99.9% monthly availability concerns service availability. These qualify system behavior and need distinct checks.

explanation.zh: 练习中的密码存储保护描述安全约束；手机、平板和桌面正确显示描述跨设备适配。这里进行需求类型辨析，并不把练习中的“加密密码”措辞作为实际安全实现建议。
explanation.en: The exercise’s password-storage protection describes a security constraint, while correct display on phones, tablets and desktops describes device adaptation. This is requirement classification, not an endorsement of the exercise’s “encrypt passwords” wording as implementation advice.

title.zh: 含糊形容词与可验证性

explanation.zh: “安全登录”“容易使用”只有方向，缺少可检查条件。需要说明适用用户、场景和验收依据；不能仅凭开发者个人感觉判定达标。
explanation.en: “Log in securely” and “easy to use” state directions but lack checkable conditions. Specify relevant users, scenarios and acceptance evidence instead of relying solely on a developer’s impression.

title.zh: 数量指标仍需运行条件
title.en: Numeric metrics still need operating conditions

explanation.zh: 每秒处理一百笔交易比“速度快”更具体，但仍需明确交易类型、负载和测试条件。数字提高可验证性，不能自动消除所有歧义。
explanation.en: One hundred transactions per second is more specific than “fast,” but transaction type, workload and test conditions still need definition. Numbers improve verifiability without automatically removing every ambiguity.

explanation.zh: “成功付款后十秒内发送短信”明确了触发事件、动作和时间上限，比无条件的“及时通知”更可检查。进一步验收还应一致定义发送成功的判定点。
explanation.en: “Send an SMS within ten seconds after successful payment” names a trigger, action and time bound, making it more checkable than “notify promptly.” Acceptance should also define consistently what counts as successful sending.

title.zh: 绝对化承诺与权限边界

explanation.zh: “永不丢失数据”没有说明故障与恢复条件，不能用有限测试证明绝对的“永不”。“禁止未授权者查看机密文件”方向较具体，但仍需定义授权角色与机密文件范围。
explanation.en: “Never lose customer data” lacks failure/recovery conditions, and finite tests cannot prove an absolute “never.” Preventing unauthorized access to confidential files is more specific, but authorized roles and confidential scope still require definition.

relation.zh: 区分做什么与做得怎样
relation.en: Distinguish what is done from how well

relation.zh: 质量指标需要可重复的测试条件
relation.en: Quality metrics need reproducible test conditions

relation.zh: 把模糊词改为事件与界限
relation.en: Replace vague wording with events and bounds

relation.zh: 明确条件可避免无限承诺
relation.en: Explicit conditions avoid unlimited promises

prompt.zh: 哪一组都主要描述功能？
prompt.en: Which pair primarily describes functions?

options.zh: 两秒内加载；每月可用率 99.9%
options.en: Load within two seconds; 99.9% monthly availability

options.zh: 支持五千并发；跨设备显示
options.en: Support five thousand concurrent users; display across devices

options.zh: 响应速度；资源消耗
options.en: Response speed; resource consumption

options.zh: 生成月报；管理员停用账户
options.en: Generate a monthly report; administrators deactivate accounts

explanation.zh: 前一组是系统做的事情，其他组侧重性能、可用性、容量或适配质量。
explanation.en: The correct pair names system actions; the other pairs concern performance, availability, capacity or adaptation.

prompt.zh: “两秒内加载”“五千并发”“99.9% 月可用率”的对应关系是哪项？
prompt.en: Which mapping fits “load in two seconds,” “five thousand concurrent users,” and “99.9% monthly availability”?

options.zh: 容量；可用性；响应性能
options.en: Capacity; availability; response performance

options.zh: 响应性能；容量；可用性
options.en: Response performance; capacity; availability

options.zh: 可用性；响应性能；容量
options.en: Availability; response performance; capacity

options.zh: 响应性能；可用性；容量
options.en: Response performance; availability; capacity

explanation.zh: 这些都属于质量要求，但测量对象不同，不能互相替代。
explanation.en: All are quality requirements, but their measured properties differ and are not interchangeable.

prompt.zh: 密码存储保护和多设备正确显示主要是在规定什么？
prompt.en: What do password-storage protection and correct multiple-device display primarily specify?

options.zh: 仅属于新增业务功能，与质量约束无关
options.en: Only new business functions, unrelated to quality constraints

options.zh: 安全与兼容/适配方面的非功能要求
options.en: Non-functional requirements for security and compatibility/adaptation

options.zh: 仅属于内容要求，与安全或兼容性无关
options.en: Only content requirements, unrelated to security or compatibility

options.zh: 仅属于团队时间表，不约束系统行为
options.en: Only team scheduling, with no system-behavior constraint

explanation.zh: 两者约束实现应有的保护或适配性质，而不是新增一种业务报表或身份字段。
explanation.en: They constrain protection or adaptation properties rather than adding a business report or identity field.

prompt.zh: 为什么“系统应容易使用”不足以直接作为验收标准？
prompt.en: Why is “the system shall be easy to use” insufficient as a direct acceptance criterion?

options.zh: 因为只有功能需求可以有验收标准
options.en: Because only functional requirements can have acceptance criteria

options.zh: 没有给出用户、任务和可检查的判据
options.en: It lacks users, tasks and checkable criteria

options.zh: 因为需求必须先指定实现语言才有意义
options.en: Because requirements mean nothing before selecting a language

options.zh: 因为把“容易”改成“非常容易”就足够精确
options.en: Because “very easy” is precise enough instead of “easy”

explanation.zh: 问题是缺少具体条件，不是可用性不重要或非功能无法验证。
explanation.en: The issue is missing specific conditions, not that usability is unimportant or non-functional requirements cannot be checked.

prompt.zh: 对于“每秒处理一百笔交易”，哪项补充最有助于验收？
prompt.en: For “process one hundred transactions per second,” which addition most helps acceptance testing?

options.zh: 增加一句“使用先进技术”但不规定工作负载
options.en: Add “use advanced technology” without specifying workload

options.zh: 只规定开发机器品牌，不规定交易内容
options.en: Specify only the development machine brand without transaction content

options.zh: 明确交易类型及负载条件
options.en: Define transaction type and workload conditions

options.zh: 只规定首页颜色，假设性能与负载无关
options.en: Specify only home-page colors, assuming load is irrelevant

explanation.zh: 可复现测试依赖明确的工作量和环境；模糊形容词或删除指标会降低可检查性。
explanation.en: Reproducible tests need a defined workload and environment; vague adjectives or removing metrics reduces checkability.

prompt.zh: 哪个表述包含清楚的事件、动作和时间上限？
prompt.en: Which statement gives a clear event, action and time bound?

options.zh: 系统应在成功付款后尽快发送短信
options.en: The system should send an SMS promptly after successful payment

options.zh: 系统应在十秒内完成适当操作
options.en: The system should perform an appropriate operation within ten seconds

options.zh: 系统应通过短信及时告知重要信息
options.en: The system should promptly notify important information by SMS

options.zh: 成功付款后十秒内发送短信
options.en: Send an SMS within ten seconds of successful payment

explanation.zh: 支付成功是触发，发短信是动作，十秒是上限；其余表述缺少可检查的具体条件。
explanation.en: Successful payment is the trigger, SMS the action and ten seconds the bound; the alternatives lack checkable specifics.

prompt.zh: 如何改进“永不丢失客户数据”这样的要求？
prompt.en: How can a requirement such as “never lose customer data” be improved?

options.zh: 用“绝对可靠”替代“永不”但不增加条件
options.en: Replace “never” with “absolutely reliable” without conditions

options.zh: 只写出备份工具名便视为覆盖所有故障
options.en: Name a backup tool and assume every failure is covered

options.zh: 把数据安全改成用户自行负责而不定义系统责任
options.en: Make data safety solely the user’s responsibility without system obligations

options.zh: 明确故障场景和可检查的恢复/保存要求
options.en: Define failure scenarios and checkable recovery/retention requirements

explanation.zh: 绝对语句缺少边界，需要具体故障与恢复条件；修辞无法成为验收证据。
explanation.en: Absolute wording lacks boundaries and needs concrete failure/recovery conditions; rhetoric cannot supply acceptance evidence.

overview.zh: 风险管理把可能妨碍项目目标的事件转成可识别、可分析、可应对并持续监控的对象，重点保护进度、预算和质量。
overview.en: Risk management turns possible threats to project goals into items that can be identified, analyzed, addressed and continually monitored, protecting schedule, budget and quality.

explanation.zh: 风险是内部或外部因素导致负面事件发生的可能性，可能阻碍项目目标。所有项目都存在风险，预防行动可以降低风险，但不能据此保证风险完全消失。
explanation.en: A risk is the possibility of a negative occurrence arising from internal or external factors and obstructing project goals. All projects face risk; preventive action can reduce it without guaranteeing its elimination.

explanation.zh: 风险管理通过降低风险来避免项目失败，重点保护时间线、预算和应用质量。只守住交付日期却牺牲全部质量，并不能代表风险管理成功。
explanation.en: Risk management reduces risk to avoid project failure, focusing on the timeline, budget and application quality. Meeting the date while sacrificing all quality is not complete success.

explanation.zh: 先识别可能性较大或影响较高的风险，如人手不足、建模延期和额外存储采购。识别输出应是具体可能事件，便于之后评估，而不只是“项目有问题”。
explanation.en: First identify likely or high-impact risks such as staff shortages, modelling delays or extra storage procurement. Identify specific possible events that can later be assessed, not merely “the project has problems.”

explanation.zh: 分析每项风险的严重程度并赋予影响因子，帮助项目经理判断优先级。这里的影响指后果严重性，应避免把高影响直接等同高发生概率。
explanation.en: Analyze risk severity and assign an impact factor to support prioritization. Impact concerns the severity of consequences; a high impact should not automatically be equated with a high occurrence probability.

options.zh: 关键成员可能缺席导致建模延迟

title.en: Understand the project and define the contribution

title.zh: 识别和分析利益相关者

explanation.en: In minutes 5–12, brainstorm stakeholders, classify them as primary, secondary, external or similar types, and describe their needs during LRT construction. Produce a classified stakeholder list.

explanation.zh: 12–20 分钟基于已识别利益相关者，选择四个真实施工情境，把它们投射为应用功能。输出四项功能，确保功能由情境驱动。
explanation.en: In minutes 12–20, choose four real construction scenarios based on identified stakeholders and translate them into app functions. The output is four functions driven by scenarios.

title.en: Derive both requirement types from scenarios

explanation.zh: 20–30 分钟针对四个场景提出主要功能需求，同时识别可用性、性能、安全、可访问性等相关非功能需求。输出同时包含两类要求的列表。
explanation.en: In minutes 20–30, derive main functional requirements for the four scenarios and relevant non-functional requirements such as usability, performance, security and accessibility. Produce a list covering both types.

title.zh: 汇总商业提案中的 RE 部分

explanation.zh: 30–40 分钟把前面成果写入商业提案的需求工程部分，包含关键利益相关者、四项功能的简述以及主要功能和非功能需求。每项内容应能追溯到前面的场景分析。
explanation.en: In minutes 30–40, write the proposal’s RE section using the earlier outputs: key stakeholders, short descriptions of four functions, and principal functional/non-functional requirements. Each item should trace back to scenario analysis.

explanation.en: Stakeholder analysis precedes scenarios, and scenarios ground functions rather than becoming post-hoc justifications.

options.en: Also consider relevant usability, performance, security and accessibility requirements

options.zh: 先定实现框架，再把前面需求改写成框架广告
