options.zh: 提前安排知识共享和可接替的职责
options.en: Arrange knowledge sharing and backup responsibilities in advance

options.zh: 再次描述缺席的可能后果但不安排任何措施
options.en: Describe absence consequences again without arranging a response

options.zh: 只提高风险等级，不确定责任或行动
options.en: Raise the risk rating without deciding responsibility or action

options.zh: 仅在项目结束时统计实际损失
options.en: Only count actual losses after the project ends

explanation.zh: 计划把分析结果转成预防或缓解行动；列名和等待都没有形成应对。
explanation.en: Planning translates analysis into preventive or mitigating action; naming or waiting does not create a response.

prompt.zh: 某项缓解措施执行后，团队应该继续做什么？
prompt.en: After a mitigation action is implemented, what should the team continue doing?

options.zh: 只要措施已执行就将风险永久关闭
options.en: Close the risk permanently as soon as an action is executed

options.zh: 仅在最终报告中回顾，不在运行中检查
options.en: Review only in the final report, not during execution

options.zh: 维持初始评分，无论环境如何变化
options.en: Keep the initial rating regardless of environmental change

options.zh: 监测风险和措施效果，必要时调整
options.en: Monitor the risk and action effectiveness and adjust if necessary

explanation.zh: 监控与控制检验措施的效果和新变化，是持续过程而不是一次性文件。
explanation.en: Monitoring and control check response effectiveness and new changes as an ongoing process.

prompt.zh: 不停增加未规划的功能，最直接属于哪类风险？
prompt.en: Continually adding unplanned functions most directly indicates which risk category?

options.zh: 技术风险，例如所选组件无法集成
options.en: Technical risk such as incompatible components

options.zh: 运营/管理风险，例如角色交接不足
options.en: Operational/management risk such as poor handover

options.zh: 已完成风险响应，不再属于范围管理
options.en: A completed response, no longer a scope concern

options.zh: 项目范围风险
options.en: Project-scope risk

explanation.zh: 新增未规划功能改变范围，并可能进一步影响进度与预算；分类用于聚焦应对，不排除交叉影响。
explanation.en: Unplanned functions change scope and may also affect time and cost; categorization focuses treatment without excluding overlaps.

prompt.zh: 哪项最符合本页的小组风险活动？
prompt.en: Which response best fits this page’s group risk activity?

options.zh: 仅复述其他项目的风险，不分析本组条件
options.en: Repeat risks from another project without examining this group’s conditions

options.zh: 仅列风险类别名称，不描述可能事件和影响
options.en: List category labels without possible events or impacts

options.zh: 分析本组技术集成可能延期的原因、影响和应对
options.en: Analyze why the group’s integration may be delayed, its impact and response

options.zh: 先承诺项目不会延期，再省略风险讨论
options.en: Promise no delay first and omit risk discussion

explanation.zh: 活动要求把理论应用于本组具体情境，具体事件与应对比只记术语更能支持项目管理。
explanation.en: The activity applies theory to the group’s context; concrete events and responses support management better than terminology alone.

reason.zh: 章节标题页。
reason.en: Section title slide.

sourceNote.zh: 第 2–6 页与 Week 3 风险管理内容对应，第 7 页继续要求小组识别自己项目的风险；保留独立学习与答题记录。
sourceNote.en: Pages 2–6 correspond to the Week 3 risk-management content; page 7 asks groups to identify their own project risks. This resource retains separate study and quiz records.

overview.zh: 模型把文字需求转成可以核对的结构、角色和交互。沿着用户与内容模型、功能交互图、界面原型和运行配置，检查同一应用的不同视角是否一致。
overview.en: Models translate written requirements into checkable structures, roles and interactions. Follow user/content models, functional interaction diagrams, prototypes and configuration to check whether different views of the same application agree.

title.zh: 模型的作用与过程位置
title.en: Purpose and process position of models
Use models to reduce textual ambiguity

explanation.zh: 文字提案可能满足字面描述却不符合实际意图，课件用一升洒水壶的反常设计作例。模型用图、文字和流程表示内容、功能、组件、接口、导航与外观，使假设可以被讨论和验证。
explanation.en: A written proposal can match literal wording yet miss intent, illustrated by the awkward one-litre watering-can design. Models use diagrams, text and flows to represent content, functions, components, interfaces, navigation and appearance so assumptions can be discussed and checked.

title.zh: 增量过程中的分析与设计
title.en: Analysis and design in the incremental process

explanation.zh: 课件过程模型由沟通、规划、建模、构建和部署组成，每个增量循环开展。建模包含分析和设计，因此既解释问题，也形成解决方案，之后通过构建与交付检验。
explanation.en: The process cycles through communication, planning, modelling, construction and deployment for each increment. Modelling includes analysis and design: explaining the problem and shaping its solution, then checking it through construction and delivery.

explanation.zh: 用户建模识别全部用户类型及访问权限。示例把访客、注册用户、房主等区分开，提醒同一功能或内容不一定向每类用户开放。
explanation.en: User modelling identifies user types and access rights. The example distinguishes guests, registered users and homeowners, showing that a function or content item need not be available to every user type.

explanation.zh: 内容覆盖应用提供的文字、图形、图片、视频和音频。建模时要识别内容对象及其组织关系，而不把内容等同网页上现成的几段文字。
explanation.en: Content spans text, graphics, images, video and audio supplied by the app. Model the content objects and their organization rather than equating content with a few existing paragraphs.

explanation.zh: 类图描述领域对象及结构。第 9 页示例分别标出类名、属性与操作；第 12 页把账户、资料、角色、会议、论文等实体展开。属性表示数据，操作表示对象支持的行为。
explanation.en: Class diagrams describe domain objects and structure. Page 9 labels class names, attributes and operations; page 12 expands accounts, profiles, roles, conferences and papers. Attributes represent data; operations represent supported behavior.

explanation.zh: 类之间的连线表示关系，端点的数量标注限制关联对象个数，组合表示整体与组成部分。模型中的多重性约束必须与功能流程相容，不能只看类名而忽略关系。
explanation.en: Connections express relationships, endpoint multiplicities constrain associated object counts, and composition expresses whole-part structure. Multiplicity constraints must agree with functional flows; class names alone are insufficient.

explanation.zh: 图中 /result 是派生属性，表示结果由其他数据推得；不变条件要求论文的作者与评审者集合不相交。类模型不仅存储数据结构，也可以表达始终应满足的业务约束。
explanation.en: The diagram marks /result as derived from other data and gives an invariant that a paper’s authors and reviewers do not overlap. A class model can express lasting business constraints as well as stored structure.

title.zh: 论文元数据、文件与状态分离
title.en: Separating paper metadata, files and status

explanation.zh: 示例用 PaperMetadata 表达题名、摘要等描述，用 PaperFile 表达文件版本和地址，用 PaperStatus 表达提交/决策状态。分开这些职责有助于理解同一业务对象的不同数据面，而非混成一个无结构文本字段。
explanation.en: The example separates PaperMetadata for title/abstract descriptions, PaperFile for versions/locations, and PaperStatus for submission/decision state. These responsibilities represent different data aspects rather than one unstructured field.

explanation.zh: 交互模型描述用户与应用在功能、内容和行为上的对话。用例图把外部参与者连接到系统提供的目标，如作者提交论文、评审者提交评审、管理员管理会议；边界区分系统提供的能力与外部角色。
explanation.en: Interaction models describe conversations between users and the app in function, content and behavior. Use-case diagrams link external actors to goals such as submitting papers/reviews or managing a conference; the boundary separates offered capabilities from external roles.

explanation.zh: 序列图沿时间顺序表示参与者和对象间的消息，适合检验一个用例如何完成。它不同于仅列出功能的用例图，也不同于强调实体结构的类图。
explanation.en: A sequence diagram shows messages among actors and objects in time order to examine how a use case completes. It differs from a use-case inventory of goals and a class diagram of entity structure.

explanation.zh: 示例先向 ConferenceInfo 检查提交窗口，再创建 PaperMetadata 取得 paperId，随后向 PaperFile 上传文件并取得确认，然后更新 PaperStatus 并返回提交确认。标识符把不同对象中的操作串成同一业务过程。
explanation.en: The example checks the submission window with ConferenceInfo, creates PaperMetadata to obtain paperId, uploads to PaperFile and receives confirmation, then updates PaperStatus and returns submission confirmation. Identifiers connect separate object operations into one business process.

title.en: Purpose and limits of interface prototypes

explanation.zh: 原型表达界面、内容、交互机制、导航和整体布局，让用户更早看见想法。课件此处允许链接尚未激活，并强调原型会修改；原型用于澄清设计，不等于已完成可运行系统。
explanation.en: Prototypes express interface, content, interaction, navigation and layout so users see ideas early. Here the lecture allows inactive links and expects revision; a prototype clarifies design but is not a completed working system.

title.zh: 运行环境与跨视角一致性
title.en: Runtime environment and consistency across views

explanation.zh: 配置模型考虑服务器、硬件、操作系统、云或内网位置、服务器与数据库互操作，以及客户端浏览器和平台。它回答系统在哪运行和怎样连接；课件把状态图、导航上下文也列为交互表达的选择，具体图型应按问题选用。
explanation.en: Configuration modelling considers servers, hardware, operating systems, cloud/intranet placement, server/database interoperability and client browsers/platforms. It answers where the system runs and connects. The lecture also lists state diagrams and navigation context as interaction alternatives; choose a view for the question being examined.

relation.zh: 用可讨论模型支撑增量过程
relation.en: Discussable models support the incremental process

relation.zh: 角色和权限决定可参与哪些用例
relation.en: Roles and rights determine use-case participation

relation.zh: 内容对象可以结构化为类
relation.en: Content objects can be structured as classes

relation.zh: 对象需要关系与数量约束
relation.en: Objects need relationships and quantity constraints

relation.zh: 结构约束进一步承载业务不变量
relation.en: Structural constraints also carry business invariants

relation.zh: 分离的内容职责在提交过程中协作
relation.en: Separated content responsibilities collaborate in submission

relation.zh: 功能目标细化为消息次序
relation.en: Functional goals are elaborated into message sequences

relation.zh: 序列图在论文提交实例中应用
relation.en: Apply sequence modelling to paper submission

relation.zh: 用例通过原型让用户检验
relation.en: Prototypes let users examine use cases

relation.zh: 界面方案还需符合运行环境
relation.en: Interface proposals must fit the runtime environment

prompt.zh: 需求写明“容量一升且有洒水口”，产品却不方便实际浇水，模型最能帮助什么？
prompt.en: A requirement says “one litre with a sprinkler,” but the result is awkward to water with. How can modelling help?

options.zh: 把容量写得更精确便可跳过使用情境验证
options.en: Specify capacity more precisely and skip usage-context validation

options.zh: 只验证文件格式，不检查使用方式
options.en: Check only document formatting, not how the product is used

options.zh: 显露形态和使用假设，以核对真实意图
options.en: Expose form and usage assumptions so actual intent can be checked

options.zh: 以完成全部功能文字为准，不再展示设计
options.en: Treat literal functional completion as sufficient without showing the design

explanation.zh: 模型让隐含假设变得可见，不能只靠更长文字或更早编码消除歧义。
explanation.en: Models make hidden assumptions visible; longer wording or earlier coding alone does not remove ambiguity.

prompt.zh: 建模在课件增量过程中的位置如何理解？
prompt.en: How should modelling be understood in the lecture’s incremental process?

options.zh: 沟通和规划后进行分析与设计，支撑构建和部署
options.en: Analysis/design after communication and planning support construction and deployment

options.zh: 沟通、规划后直接构建，建模只在最终验收补写
options.en: Build immediately after planning and write models only at final acceptance

options.zh: 先固定最终设计，再开展所有用户沟通
options.en: Fix the final design before any user communication

options.zh: 建模完成后无需再经历构建和部署
options.en: Once modelling is complete, construction/deployment are unnecessary

explanation.zh: 模型为后续实现提供依据，增量过程可重复；它既不替代实现，也不只是事后装饰。
explanation.en: Models ground implementation within a repeatable incremental process; they neither replace construction nor merely decorate it afterward.

prompt.zh: 公共访客只能浏览、注册用户还能购物，模型应明确什么？
prompt.en: Guests may browse while registered users can also shop. What should the model make explicit?

options.zh: 用户角色及各自可执行的交互/权限
options.en: User roles and their permitted interactions/access

options.zh: 只建立内容对象之间的数量关系
options.en: Only quantities of relationships among content objects

options.zh: 只定义消息的时间顺序，不区分角色
options.en: Only message timing without distinguishing roles

options.zh: 只确定服务器与数据库的物理位置
options.en: Only physical locations of servers and databases

explanation.zh: 角色差异及权限是用户模型重点；外观一致并不意味着权限相同。
explanation.en: Role differences and access rights are central to user models; consistent appearance does not imply identical permissions.

prompt.zh: 一个展示视频、图文和音频的教学站点，内容模型应包括什么？
prompt.en: What should the content model of a teaching site with video, text/images and audio include?

options.zh: 只列媒体文件名，不考虑其组织和关联
options.en: Only media filenames without organization or relationships

options.zh: 只列用户可执行操作，不记录信息对象
options.en: Only user actions without information objects

options.zh: 所有相关媒体对象及其组织关系
options.en: All relevant media objects and their organization

options.zh: 只列服务器组件，不描述提供给用户的内容
options.en: Only server components without user-facing content

explanation.zh: 文字、图像、视频和音频都属于课件定义的内容；仅列文件名缺少组织关系，而用户操作和服务器组件是不同建模视角。
explanation.en: Text, images, video and audio all count as content in the lecture. Filenames alone omit organization, while user actions and server components are different modelling views.

prompt.zh: 在 User 类中，email 与 login() 的主要区别是什么？
prompt.en: In a User class, what is the main distinction between email and login()?

options.zh: email是操作，login()是属性
options.en: email is an operation; login() is an attribute

options.zh: 两者都是类之间关系的多重性
options.en: Both are association multiplicities between classes

options.zh: email 是属性，login() 是操作
options.en: email is an attribute; login() is an operation

options.zh: 两者都是部署时选择的外部组件
options.en: Both are external deployment components

explanation.zh: 类图用属性表达对象的数据，用操作表达行为；它们与部署节点、参与者不同。
explanation.en: Class diagrams express object data with attributes and behavior with operations, distinct from deployment nodes or actors.

prompt.zh: 类图某端标注 0..1，最合理的解读是什么？
prompt.en: What is the best reading of 0..1 at a class-diagram association end?

options.zh: 该关系在此端必须恰好有一个对象
options.en: Exactly one object is required at that end

options.zh: 该关系在此端允许零个或一个对象
options.en: Zero or one object is allowed at that end

options.zh: 该关系允许任意多个对象
options.en: Any number of objects is allowed

options.zh: 该关系至少有一个、最多不限
options.en: At least one object is required with no upper limit

explanation.zh: 0..1表示该关联端可没有对象，也可有一个，但不能有多个；“恰好一个”“零到多个”和“至少一个”是不同多重性。
explanation.en: 0..1 allows no object or one object at that association end, but not many. Exactly one, zero-to-many and one-or-more are different multiplicities.

prompt.zh: 评审者同时也是同一论文作者，违反了示例中的什么？
prompt.en: A reviewer is also an author of the same paper. What does this violate in the example?

options.zh: 所有论文必须与恰好一个文件关联的多重性
options.en: A multiplicity requiring exactly one file per paper

options.zh: 论文结果由其他数据推导这一派生属性约定
options.en: The convention that the paper result is a derived attribute

options.zh: 服务器和客户端之间的部署约束
options.en: A deployment constraint between server and client

options.zh: 作者与评审者不相交的不变条件
options.en: The invariant that authors and reviewers do not overlap

explanation.zh: 示例的不变条件防止角色冲突，属于业务约束；它不同于界面规则或派生值计算。
explanation.en: The example invariant prevents a role conflict as a business constraint, distinct from interface rules or derived-value calculation.

prompt.zh: 需要记录论文题名、上传文件版本和当前提交状态，示例如何组织？
prompt.en: How does the example organize a paper title, uploaded-file version and current submission state?

options.zh: 分别放在元数据、文件和状态对象中并建立关系
options.en: Use related metadata, file and status objects

options.zh: 只用一个未区分含义的字符串保存全部信息
options.en: Store all information in one string without distinguishing meaning

options.zh: 把所有数据只放在用户角色定义中
options.en: Put all data solely in the user-role definition

options.zh: 仅在序列图中写消息，不建立对应内容对象
options.en: Write only sequence messages without corresponding content objects

explanation.zh: 图把描述、文件和状态视为关联但不同职责；合理分离支撑后续交互流程。
explanation.en: The diagram treats description, file and state as related but distinct responsibilities, supporting later interaction flows.

prompt.zh: 要说明“谁可以使用哪些系统功能”，最直接采用什么模型？
prompt.en: Which model most directly explains who can use which system functions?

options.zh: 描述对象属性和关联的类图
options.en: A class diagram of attributes and associations

options.zh: 描述对象消息时间顺序的序列图
options.en: A sequence diagram of message timing

options.zh: 用例图
options.en: Use-case diagram

options.zh: 描述运行环境的配置模型
options.en: A configuration model of the runtime environment

explanation.zh: 用例把参与者和功能目标联系起来；配置、样式或字段表无法单独表达这种关系。
explanation.en: Use cases connect actors with functional goals; configurations, styles or field lists alone do not express that relationship.

prompt.zh: 要检查“先验证提交窗口，再创建记录和上传文件”的先后关系，最适合什么图？
prompt.en: Which diagram best checks “validate the submission window, then create the record and upload the file”?

options.zh: 序列图
options.en: Sequence diagram

options.zh: 类图，主要描述静态对象结构
options.en: A class diagram primarily describing static object structure

options.zh: 用例图，主要列出参与者与目标
options.en: A use-case diagram primarily listing actors and goals

options.zh: 配置模型，主要描述运行环境
options.en: A configuration model primarily describing the runtime environment

explanation.zh: 序列图显式表达消息顺序，最能核对步骤和对象协作。
explanation.en: Sequence diagrams explicitly show message order, making them suitable for checking steps and object collaboration.

prompt.zh: 为何示例先取得 paperId 再上传文件并设置状态？
prompt.en: Why does the example obtain paperId before uploading the file and setting status?

options.zh: 让标题文本代替所有对象标识，避免关系建模
options.en: Make title text replace all object identifiers to avoid relationship modelling

options.zh: 使文件与状态成为完全无关的操作
options.en: Make file and state actions completely unrelated

options.zh: 使后续文件和状态操作关联到同一论文
options.en: To associate later file and state operations with the same paper

options.zh: 跳过提交窗口检查，以缩短整个流程
options.en: Skip the submission-window check to shorten the flow

explanation.zh: paperId 在后续消息中被复用，建立同一业务实体的关联；确认消息仍然是流程一部分。
explanation.en: paperId is reused in later messages to connect the same entity, while confirmation messages remain part of the flow.

prompt.zh: 需求讨论用原型中的链接尚未激活，这最合理说明什么？
prompt.en: Links in a requirements-discussion prototype are inactive. What is the most reasonable interpretation?

options.zh: 只要原型被讨论过，最终演示就无需工作链接
options.en: Once discussed, the prototype removes the need for working demo links

options.zh: 它可用于澄清布局与流程，但不能证明最终功能已工作
options.en: It can clarify layout/flow but does not prove final functionality works

options.zh: 原型是最终规格，因此后续界面不能修改
options.en: The prototype is the final specification, so later interfaces cannot change

options.zh: 原型图已证明后台业务和数据库都正确工作
options.en: The prototype proves backend business logic and database correctness

explanation.zh: 该页区分设计探索与最终界面；不要把原型阶段的边界错误套到 Part A 工作模拟要求上。
explanation.en: The slide distinguishes design exploration from the final interface; do not misapply prototype limits to the working Part A simulation.

prompt.zh: 确认应用部署在云端、服务器如何连数据库且手机浏览器可访问，主要属于哪一视角？
prompt.en: Confirming cloud deployment, server/database connectivity and mobile-browser access mainly belongs to which view?

options.zh: 配置模型
options.en: Configuration model

options.zh: 用户模型，主要关注角色与权限
options.en: A user model primarily concerning roles and access

options.zh: 内容模型，主要关注信息对象与关联
options.en: A content model primarily concerning information objects and relationships

options.zh: 用例模型，主要关注用户功能目标
options.en: A use-case model primarily concerning user functional goals

explanation.zh: 这些信息描述运行环境和组件互操作，属于配置；用例、内容和视觉原型各有不同关注点。
explanation.en: These describe runtime conditions and interoperability, hence configuration; use cases, content and visual prototypes address different concerns.

reason.zh: 标题、小组报告讨论提示与结束页，没有新的建模概念。
reason.en: Title, group-report discussion prompt and closing slide add no new modelling concepts.

overview.zh: 从设计目标和质量维度进入界面设计，逐项理解用户定位、可选动作、导航和有效交互原则。页内重复的沟通原则合并解释，避免把重复幻灯片当成新知识。
overview.en: Move from design goals and quality dimensions to interface design, including user orientation, available actions, navigation and effective-interaction principles. The repeated communication principle is explained once rather than counted as new content.

title.zh: 内容、信息、交互与功能设计
title.en: Content, information, interaction and functional design

explanation.zh: Web 设计同时涵盖内容、审美、架构、界面和导航。课件随后区分交互、信息和功能设计：分别思考用户怎样操作、信息怎样组织以及系统怎样支持任务；这些视角共同形成体验。
explanation.en: Web design covers content, aesthetics, architecture, interface and navigation. The lecture then distinguishes interaction, information and functional design: how users act, how information is organized and how system functions support tasks, jointly shaping experience.

explanation.zh: 设计应避免功能堆积，保持适度和简单。简洁要求保留对用户目标有帮助的能力并降低不必要复杂度，不是随意删除关键功能。
explanation.en: Design should avoid feature bloat and favor moderation and simplicity. Simplicity retains capabilities useful for user goals while reducing unnecessary complexity, rather than arbitrarily deleting essential functions.

title.zh: 跨页面与跨机制的一致性

explanation.zh: 图形风格、架构模板、导航方式、菜单和图标应一致，使用户在一个位置学会的规则能迁移到别处。视觉一致和操作一致都重要，不能只统一颜色。
explanation.en: Visual style, architecture templates, navigation, menus and icons should be consistent so learned rules transfer across the app. Both appearance and behavior matter; matching colors alone is insufficient.

explanation.zh: 身份目标要求审美、界面与导航符合应用领域；兼容性要求考虑不同硬件、连接、操作系统和浏览器。前者是体验是否符合用途，后者是能否适应使用环境。
explanation.en: Identity asks whether aesthetics, interface and navigation fit the application domain; compatibility considers hardware, connections, operating systems and browsers. The first concerns fit to purpose, the second fit to usage environments.

explanation.zh: 用户期待内容和功能可靠、有用并与自己的需要相关。稳健性不仅是页面能够加载，还包括用户可以依赖其内容与行为完成任务。
explanation.en: Users expect robust content and functions relevant to their needs. Robustness is more than a page loading: users should be able to rely on content and behavior to accomplish tasks.

title.zh: 可导航性与视觉吸引力

explanation.zh: 可导航性让用户无需寻找说明就理解如何移动；视觉吸引力来自布局、颜色、文字与媒体的平衡等。好看不必然好找路，评估时应分别观察。
explanation.en: Navigability lets users understand movement without hunting for instructions. Visual appeal comes from layout, color and the balance of text and media. Attractive appearance does not guarantee clear routes, so assess them separately.

explanation.zh: 质量树把全站易理解程度、在线反馈与帮助、界面与审美特征以及特殊功能列在可用性下。可用性评价要看用户能否理解并使用系统，而不是仅统计功能个数。
explanation.en: The quality tree places site understandability, online feedback/help, interface/aesthetic features and special features under usability. Evaluate whether users understand and operate the system, not just the number of functions.

explanation.zh: 质量树中的功能性包括搜索与检索、导航与浏览，以及应用领域相关功能。功能性评价检查任务所需能力是否具备，而不是只看菜单是否漂亮。
explanation.en: Functionality in the quality tree includes search/retrieval, navigation/browsing and domain-related features. Evaluate whether task capabilities exist rather than merely whether menus are attractive.

explanation.zh: 可靠性分支包含链接正确处理、错误恢复和用户输入验证与恢复。系统在错误或不合法输入出现时仍应以可预期方式处理，不能只在理想输入下工作。
explanation.en: Reliability includes correct link handling, error recovery and input validation/recovery. The system should behave predictably when errors or invalid inputs occur rather than working only with ideal input.

explanation.zh: 质量树中的效率关注响应时间、页面生成速度和图形生成速度。这里评价的是运行表现，应与后文“优化用户工作效率”的界面原则区分。
explanation.en: Efficiency in the quality tree concerns response time, page generation and graphics generation. This evaluates runtime behavior and should be distinguished from the later interface principle of optimizing the user’s work efficiency.

explanation.zh: 可维护性分支包括纠错容易程度、适应能力和可扩展性。结构清楚、修改影响可控有助于后续改进；它评价维护工作，不等同于当前用户看到的加载速度。
explanation.en: Maintainability includes ease of correction, adaptability and extensibility. Clear structure and controlled change impact help future improvement; this concerns maintenance effort rather than users’ current load times.

title.zh: 交互中的三个定位问题
当前位置、当前动作与来路
title.en: Current location, available actions and history

explanation.zh: 界面应回答“我在哪里”“现在能做什么”“我从哪里来/可以去哪里”。它需要标明内容层级位置、可用功能与链接，并提供易理解的路径或地图。
explanation.en: The interface should answer where the user is, what they can do now, and where they have been/can go. Indicate the content-hierarchy location, available functions/links and understandable paths or maps.

explanation.zh: 预期原则要求界面考虑用户下一步可能要做什么，并把适合当前任务的后续动作放在可理解的位置。它支持用户意图，而不是替用户未经确认地执行所有操作。
explanation.en: Anticipation means considering what users are likely to do next and making appropriate next actions understandable. It supports intent rather than executing every action without confirmation.

explanation.zh: 用户发起活动后，界面应说明正在处理、成功或出现问题等状态。第 8、9 页重复同一原则，核心是让用户知道操作进展，减少反复点击和不确定感。
explanation.en: After a user initiates an activity, the interface should communicate processing, success or problems. Pages 8 and 9 repeat this principle: make progress known to reduce repeated clicking and uncertainty.

explanation.zh: 界面应优化用户完成工作的效率，而非只让开发者实现方便或服务器执行省事。衡量时考虑用户完成任务的步骤和负担，与系统响应性能既相关又不同。
explanation.en: The interface should optimize user work efficiency, not merely developer convenience or server execution. Consider task steps and user effort, which relate to but differ from response performance.

explanation.zh: 允许用户在应用中自主移动，同时保持一致的导航约定和可理解边界。它既不是把用户锁死在唯一路径，也不是让每个页面采用完全不同的控制方式。
explanation.en: Let users move autonomously while preserving established navigation conventions and understandable boundaries. This is neither locking users into one path nor changing controls unpredictably on every page.

explanation.zh: 界面应让明确目标的用户直接完成任务，也允许探索型用户浏览后再决定。不同操作风格可以共享相同任务目标，而不必强迫所有人走同一路径。
explanation.en: The interface should let goal-directed users act directly while allowing exploratory users to browse before deciding. Different styles can serve the same goal without forcing everyone through an identical path.

explanation.zh: 界面和内容应围绕用户当前任务保持聚焦，减少无关信息竞争注意力。聚焦不意味着删除完成任务所必需的帮助或上下文。
explanation.en: Interface and content should remain centered on the current task and reduce irrelevant competition for attention. Focus does not mean removing necessary help or context.

explanation.zh: 遇到复杂图片等耗时操作，界面可通过并行或后台处理让用户继续其他工作，减少等待阻塞。它改善等待体验，不应假装尚未成功的不可逆操作已经完成。
explanation.en: For slow work such as loading complex images, concurrency or background processing can let users continue other tasks and reduce blocking. This improves waiting experience without falsely claiming an unsuccessful irreversible action has completed.

explanation.zh: 界面应减少初次学习时间，也减少再次访问时的重学成本。稳定、清楚的操作方式让用户能把以前学会的规则重新用起来。
explanation.en: The interface should reduce initial learning time and relearning on return. Stable, clear interactions let users reuse what they previously learned.

explanation.zh: 恰当隐喻利用用户熟悉的类比帮助学习，如把收藏表达为书签。隐喻必须适合用户和应用，不能只因图标看起来熟悉就忽略其实际含义。
explanation.en: Appropriate metaphors use familiar analogies to support learning, such as bookmarks for saved items. A metaphor must fit the users and application rather than merely look familiar.

explanation.zh: 界面信息应对不同年龄用户保持可读，文字、布局与呈现方式都需支持理解。可读性不等于仅把字体做大，也要避免影响辨认的组织和对比问题。
explanation.en: Interface information should remain readable for users of different ages, with text, layout and presentation supporting understanding. Readability is more than enlarging fonts; organization and distinguishability also matter.

explanation.zh: 在适当场景保存交互状态，使用户退出后回来可以从上次位置继续。它强调任务连续性，不能把不同账号的个人状态混合在一起。
explanation.en: Where appropriate, preserve interaction state so users can leave and later resume. This supports task continuity and should not mix personal state across accounts.

title.zh: 可见导航与稳定工作环境
title.en: Visible navigation and a stable working context

explanation.zh: 良好导航让用户感到工作内容来到自己面前，而不是不断迷失于新的位置。保持可见、可理解的导航线索和稳定上下文，有助于用户掌握位置与行动。
explanation.en: Good navigation makes users feel that work is brought to them instead of losing their place repeatedly. Visible, understandable navigation cues and a stable context help users remain oriented and in control.

explanation.zh: 该原则把用户工作效率放在中心，开发便利不能成为增加用户重复劳动的充分理由。
explanation.en: The principle centers user efficiency; implementation convenience alone does not justify redundant user work.

prompt.zh: 哪种导航最符合受控自主性？
prompt.en: Which navigation best fits controlled autonomy?

options.zh: 允许自由返回与切换，同时沿用一致导航约定
options.en: Allow returning/switching while preserving consistent conventions

options.zh: 为了保持一致，强迫用户始终按唯一顺序前进
options.en: Force one fixed sequence to maintain consistency

options.zh: 允许自由移动，但每个页面独立定义相同控件的含义
options.en: Allow movement while each page defines identical controls differently

options.zh: 系统替用户决定所有下一步，以减少选择
options.en: Have the system decide every next step to reduce choices

explanation.zh: 自主移动与既定约定必须同时存在；任意变化或过度限制都偏离该原则。
explanation.en: Autonomous movement and established conventions must coexist; arbitrary changes or excessive restrictions violate the principle.

prompt.zh: 提供搜索直达以及按类别浏览两条找资料路径，最体现什么？
prompt.en: Providing direct search and category browsing for finding materials most clearly illustrates what?

options.zh: 状态跟踪
options.en: State tracking

options.zh: 领域身份
options.en: Domain identity

options.zh: 灵活性
options.en: Flexibility

options.zh: 运行效率
options.en: Runtime efficiency

explanation.zh: 直接任务和探索路径并存，照顾不同用户方式，体现界面灵活性。
explanation.en: Direct and exploratory routes accommodate different user styles, demonstrating flexibility.

prompt.zh: 填写施工问题表单时出现大量无关促销弹窗，应优先改善什么？
prompt.en: Many unrelated promotional popups interrupt a construction-concern form. What should be improved?

options.zh: 可移植性
options.en: Portability

options.zh: 任务聚焦
options.en: Task focus

options.zh: 状态跟踪
options.en: State tracking

options.zh: 跨浏览器兼容性
options.en: Cross-browser compatibility

explanation.zh: 无关内容干扰当前任务；聚焦需要保留相关帮助并减少分心项。
explanation.en: Irrelevant content distracts from the task; focus retains relevant help while reducing distractions.

prompt.zh: 大图加载时仍允许阅读文字和浏览其他内容，最符合哪个原则？
prompt.en: Allowing text reading and other browsing while a large image loads best fits which principle?

options.zh: 可读性
options.en: Readability

options.zh: 状态跟踪
options.en: State tracking

options.zh: 领域身份
options.en: Domain identity

options.zh: 延迟降低
options.en: Latency reduction

explanation.zh: 非阻塞处理降低等待对任务的影响；它应与状态沟通配合，而不是隐藏真实状态。
explanation.en: Nonblocking processing reduces the effect of waiting and should accompany status communication, not conceal it.

prompt.zh: 用户隔几周回来仍能迅速完成任务，说明哪项原则执行得较好？
prompt.en: Users return after several weeks and quickly complete tasks. Which principle is working well?

options.zh: 运行效率
options.en: Runtime efficiency

options.zh: 跨环境可移植性
options.en: Cross-environment portability

options.zh: 易学性
options.en: Learnability

options.zh: 后台数据一致性
options.en: Backend data consistency

explanation.zh: 易学性包括重学成本；保持可理解的交互有助于回访用户恢复操作。
explanation.en: Learnability includes relearning effort; understandable interactions help returning users resume work.

prompt.zh: 用“书签”表示以后再看的资料，何时是合适设计？
prompt.en: When is using a bookmark for materials to revisit appropriate?

options.zh: 开发者熟悉这个图标即可，无需考虑目标用户
options.en: Developer familiarity is sufficient regardless of target users

options.zh: 只要外观相似，操作意义可以与现实类比相反
options.en: Visual similarity is enough even if behavior contradicts the analogy

options.zh: 隐喻越抽象越好，以迫使用户学习新规则
options.en: More abstract metaphors are better because they force new learning

options.zh: 用户能理解该类比且行为与其含义相符
options.en: Users understand the analogy and behavior matches its meaning

explanation.zh: 恰当隐喻利用用户熟悉的类比帮助学习，如把收藏表达为书签。隐喻必须适合用户和应用，不能只因图标看起来熟悉就忽略其实际含义。
explanation.en: Appropriate metaphors use familiar analogies to support learning, such as bookmarks for saved items. A metaphor must fit the users and application rather than merely look familiar.

prompt.zh: 低对比度细小文本让用户难以读清，最直接应改善什么？
prompt.en: Low-contrast tiny text is hard to read. What should be improved most directly?

options.zh: 可读性
options.en: Readability

options.zh: 预期用户下一步
options.en: Anticipating the next user action

options.zh: 跟踪用户交互状态
options.en: Tracking user interaction state

options.zh: 多层架构的可维护性
options.en: Maintainability of layered architecture

explanation.zh: 低对比度和细小文字直接影响信息辨认，属于可读性；预期下一步、保存状态和代码维护各自解决不同问题。
explanation.en: Low contrast and tiny text directly affect recognition, hence readability. Anticipating actions, preserving state and maintaining code address different problems.

prompt.zh: 用户重新登录后恢复先前阅读位置和草稿，最体现哪个原则？
prompt.en: Restoring a user’s reading position and draft after login most clearly illustrates which principle?

options.zh: 动作状态沟通，只显示本次请求的处理状态
options.en: Action-status communication showing only the current request state

options.zh: 跟踪并保存状态
options.en: Tracking and storing state

options.zh: 延迟降低，只允许下载时继续操作
options.en: Latency reduction allowing work during downloads

options.zh: 兼容性，只适配不同浏览器
options.en: Compatibility adapting only to different browsers

explanation.zh: 保存状态让同一用户延续任务；带宽或视觉变化不能替代任务状态，跨账号合并也不是该原则。
explanation.en: Stored state provides continuity for the same user; bandwidth/appearance do not replace task state, and cross-account mixing is not the principle.

prompt.zh: 切换课程内容时保留清楚的导航与当前位置，主要支持什么？
prompt.en: Keeping clear navigation and current-location cues while switching course content primarily supports what?

options.zh: 可见导航与稳定工作上下文
options.en: Visible navigation and a stable working context

options.zh: 延迟降低，主要缩短计算等待
options.en: Latency reduction, mainly reducing computation waiting

options.zh: 可读性，主要改善文字辨认
options.en: Readability, mainly improving text recognition

options.zh: 领域身份，主要匹配应用主题
options.en: Domain identity, mainly matching the application domain

explanation.zh: 稳定线索降低迷路感，使内容变化不破坏用户的工作位置感。
explanation.en: Stable cues reduce disorientation so content changes do not destroy the user’s sense of working context.

reason.zh: 章节标题页。
reason.en: Section title slide.

overview.zh: 从设计目标和质量维度进入界面设计，逐项理解用户定位、可选动作、导航和有效交互原则。页内重复的沟通原则合并解释，避免把重复幻灯片当成新知识。
overview.en: Move from design goals and quality dimensions to interface design, including user orientation, available actions, navigation and effective-interaction principles. The repeated communication principle is explained once rather than counted as new content.

title.zh: 内容、信息、交互与功能设计
title.en: Content, information, interaction and functional design

explanation.zh: Web 设计同时涵盖内容、审美、架构、界面和导航。课件随后区分交互、信息和功能设计：分别思考用户怎样操作、信息怎样组织以及系统怎样支持任务；这些视角共同形成体验。
explanation.en: Web design covers content, aesthetics, architecture, interface and navigation. The lecture then distinguishes interaction, information and functional design: how users act, how information is organized and how system functions support tasks, jointly shaping experience.

explanation.zh: 设计应避免功能堆积，保持适度和简单。简洁要求保留对用户目标有帮助的能力并降低不必要复杂度，不是随意删除关键功能。
explanation.en: Design should avoid feature bloat and favor moderation and simplicity. Simplicity retains capabilities useful for user goals while reducing unnecessary complexity, rather than arbitrarily deleting essential functions.

title.zh: 跨页面与跨机制的一致性

explanation.zh: 图形风格、架构模板、导航方式、菜单和图标应一致，使用户在一个位置学会的规则能迁移到别处。视觉一致和操作一致都重要，不能只统一颜色。
explanation.en: Visual style, architecture templates, navigation, menus and icons should be consistent so learned rules transfer across the app. Both appearance and behavior matter; matching colors alone is insufficient.

explanation.zh: 身份目标要求审美、界面与导航符合应用领域；兼容性要求考虑不同硬件、连接、操作系统和浏览器。前者是体验是否符合用途，后者是能否适应使用环境。
explanation.en: Identity asks whether aesthetics, interface and navigation fit the application domain; compatibility considers hardware, connections, operating systems and browsers. The first concerns fit to purpose, the second fit to usage environments.

explanation.zh: 用户期待内容和功能可靠、有用并与自己的需要相关。稳健性不仅是页面能够加载，还包括用户可以依赖其内容与行为完成任务。
explanation.en: Users expect robust content and functions relevant to their needs. Robustness is more than a page loading: users should be able to rely on content and behavior to accomplish tasks.

title.zh: 可导航性与视觉吸引力

explanation.zh: 可导航性让用户无需寻找说明就理解如何移动；视觉吸引力来自布局、颜色、文字与媒体的平衡等。好看不必然好找路，评估时应分别观察。
explanation.en: Navigability lets users understand movement without hunting for instructions. Visual appeal comes from layout, color and the balance of text and media. Attractive appearance does not guarantee clear routes, so assess them separately.

explanation.zh: 质量树把全站易理解程度、在线反馈与帮助、界面与审美特征以及特殊功能列在可用性下。可用性评价要看用户能否理解并使用系统，而不是仅统计功能个数。
explanation.en: The quality tree places site understandability, online feedback/help, interface/aesthetic features and special features under usability. Evaluate whether users understand and operate the system, not just the number of functions.

explanation.zh: 质量树中的功能性包括搜索与检索、导航与浏览，以及应用领域相关功能。功能性评价检查任务所需能力是否具备，而不是只看菜单是否漂亮。
explanation.en: Functionality in the quality tree includes search/retrieval, navigation/browsing and domain-related features. Evaluate whether task capabilities exist rather than merely whether menus are attractive.

explanation.zh: 可靠性分支包含链接正确处理、错误恢复和用户输入验证与恢复。系统在错误或不合法输入出现时仍应以可预期方式处理，不能只在理想输入下工作。
explanation.en: Reliability includes correct link handling, error recovery and input validation/recovery. The system should behave predictably when errors or invalid inputs occur rather than working only with ideal input.

explanation.zh: 质量树中的效率关注响应时间、页面生成速度和图形生成速度。这里评价的是运行表现，应与后文“优化用户工作效率”的界面原则区分。
explanation.en: Efficiency in the quality tree concerns response time, page generation and graphics generation. This evaluates runtime behavior and should be distinguished from the later interface principle of optimizing the user’s work efficiency.

explanation.zh: 可维护性分支包括纠错容易程度、适应能力和可扩展性。结构清楚、修改影响可控有助于后续改进；它评价维护工作，不等同于当前用户看到的加载速度。
explanation.en: Maintainability includes ease of correction, adaptability and extensibility. Clear structure and controlled change impact help future improvement; this concerns maintenance effort rather than users’ current load times.

title.zh: 交互中的三个定位问题
当前位置、当前动作与来路
title.en: Current location, available actions and history

explanation.zh: 界面应回答“我在哪里”“现在能做什么”“我从哪里来/可以去哪里”。它需要标明内容层级位置、可用功能与链接，并提供易理解的路径或地图。
explanation.en: The interface should answer where the user is, what they can do now, and where they have been/can go. Indicate the content-hierarchy location, available functions/links and understandable paths or maps.

explanation.zh: 预期原则要求界面考虑用户下一步可能要做什么，并把适合当前任务的后续动作放在可理解的位置。它支持用户意图，而不是替用户未经确认地执行所有操作。
explanation.en: Anticipation means considering what users are likely to do next and making appropriate next actions understandable. It supports intent rather than executing every action without confirmation.

explanation.zh: 用户发起活动后，界面应说明正在处理、成功或出现问题等状态。第 8、9 页重复同一原则，核心是让用户知道操作进展，减少反复点击和不确定感。
explanation.en: After a user initiates an activity, the interface should communicate processing, success or problems. Pages 8 and 9 repeat this principle: make progress known to reduce repeated clicking and uncertainty.

explanation.zh: 界面应优化用户完成工作的效率，而非只让开发者实现方便或服务器执行省事。衡量时考虑用户完成任务的步骤和负担，与系统响应性能既相关又不同。
explanation.en: The interface should optimize user work efficiency, not merely developer convenience or server execution. Consider task steps and user effort, which relate to but differ from response performance.

explanation.zh: 允许用户在应用中自主移动，同时保持一致的导航约定和可理解边界。它既不是把用户锁死在唯一路径，也不是让每个页面采用完全不同的控制方式。
explanation.en: Let users move autonomously while preserving established navigation conventions and understandable boundaries. This is neither locking users into one path nor changing controls unpredictably on every page.

explanation.zh: 界面应让明确目标的用户直接完成任务，也允许探索型用户浏览后再决定。不同操作风格可以共享相同任务目标，而不必强迫所有人走同一路径。
explanation.en: The interface should let goal-directed users act directly while allowing exploratory users to browse before deciding. Different styles can serve the same goal without forcing everyone through an identical path.

explanation.zh: 界面和内容应围绕用户当前任务保持聚焦，减少无关信息竞争注意力。聚焦不意味着删除完成任务所必需的帮助或上下文。
explanation.en: Interface and content should remain centered on the current task and reduce irrelevant competition for attention. Focus does not mean removing necessary help or context.

explanation.zh: 遇到复杂图片等耗时操作，界面可通过并行或后台处理让用户继续其他工作，减少等待阻塞。它改善等待体验，不应假装尚未成功的不可逆操作已经完成。
explanation.en: For slow work such as loading complex images, concurrency or background processing can let users continue other tasks and reduce blocking. This improves waiting experience without falsely claiming an unsuccessful irreversible action has completed.

explanation.zh: 界面应减少初次学习时间，也减少再次访问时的重学成本。稳定、清楚的操作方式让用户能把以前学会的规则重新用起来。
explanation.en: The interface should reduce initial learning time and relearning on return. Stable, clear interactions let users reuse what they previously learned.

explanation.zh: 恰当隐喻利用用户熟悉的类比帮助学习，如把收藏表达为书签。隐喻必须适合用户和应用，不能只因图标看起来熟悉就忽略其实际含义。
explanation.en: Appropriate metaphors use familiar analogies to support learning, such as bookmarks for saved items. A metaphor must fit the users and application rather than merely look familiar.

explanation.zh: 界面信息应对不同年龄用户保持可读，文字、布局与呈现方式都需支持理解。可读性不等于仅把字体做大，也要避免影响辨认的组织和对比问题。
explanation.en: Interface information should remain readable for users of different ages, with text, layout and presentation supporting understanding. Readability is more than enlarging fonts; organization and distinguishability also matter.

explanation.zh: 在适当场景保存交互状态，使用户退出后回来可以从上次位置继续。它强调任务连续性，不能把不同账号的个人状态混合在一起。
explanation.en: Where appropriate, preserve interaction state so users can leave and later resume. This supports task continuity and should not mix personal state across accounts.

title.zh: 可见导航与稳定工作环境
title.en: Visible navigation and a stable working context

explanation.zh: 良好导航让用户感到工作内容来到自己面前，而不是不断迷失于新的位置。保持可见、可理解的导航线索和稳定上下文，有助于用户掌握位置与行动。
explanation.en: Good navigation makes users feel that work is brought to them instead of losing their place repeatedly. Visible, understandable navigation cues and a stable context help users remain oriented and in control.

relation.zh: 设计范围由简洁目标约束
relation.en: Simplicity constrains the design scope

relation.zh: 一致控件帮助用户理解位置与动作
relation.en: Consistent controls support location and action understanding

relation.zh: 符合领域与环境有助于可用体验
relation.en: Domain and environment fit support usability

relation.zh: 稳健目标落实到错误处理质量
relation.en: Robustness becomes error-handling quality

relation.zh: 导航目标通过三个定位问题落实
relation.en: Navigation goals become the three orientation questions

relation.zh: 运行延迟可通过非阻塞交互缓解
relation.en: Nonblocking interaction mitigates runtime latency

relation.zh: 理解当前位置后预期下一步
relation.en: After orientation, anticipate the next step

relation.zh: 处理等待时仍需沟通状态
relation.en: Communicate state while managing waiting

relation.zh: 在一致约定下提供多种路径
relation.en: Offer multiple paths within consistent conventions

relation.zh: 聚焦内容还需可读呈现
relation.en: Focused content also needs readable presentation

relation.zh: 合适隐喻降低学习成本
relation.en: Appropriate metaphors reduce learning effort

relation.zh: 恢复状态配合稳定导航
relation.en: State restoration works with stable navigation

prompt.zh: 重新组织公告分类、设计浏览路线并支持问题提交，涉及哪些互补视角？
prompt.en: Reorganizing notice categories, designing browsing paths and supporting concern submission involve which complementary views?

options.zh: 信息、交互与功能设计
options.en: Information, interaction and functional design

options.zh: 数据存储、部署配置与风险排序
options.en: Data storage, deployment configuration and risk ranking

options.zh: 网络拓扑、数据库备份与容量规划
options.en: Network topology, database backup and capacity planning

options.zh: 版本管理、采购与团队排班
options.en: Version control, procurement and team scheduling

explanation.zh: 信息组织、用户行为和任务能力分别对应这三个设计面；不能只用基础设施配置代替。
explanation.en: Information organization, user behavior and task capability map to these design views; infrastructure configuration alone cannot replace them.

prompt.zh: 首页塞入大量与主任务无关的功能，优先应遵循什么目标？
prompt.en: A home page is crowded with functions unrelated to the main task. Which goal should be prioritized?

options.zh: 兼容性，增加支持的操作系统
options.en: Compatibility by adding operating systems

options.zh: 可移植性，移动数据库
options.en: Portability by moving the database

options.zh: 简洁，减少无关复杂度
options.en: Simplicity by reducing irrelevant complexity

options.zh: 用更长说明保留全部冗余功能
options.en: Keep all redundancy with longer instructions

explanation.zh: 问题是功能膨胀而非运行环境；简洁聚焦任务，不能靠增加说明消除冗余。
explanation.en: The issue is feature bloat rather than environment support; simplicity focuses tasks, and longer instructions do not remove redundancy.

prompt.zh: 同一个“返回”图标在不同页面执行不同动作，违背什么原则？
prompt.en: The same Back icon performs different actions on different pages. Which principle is violated?

options.zh: 兼容性
options.en: Compatibility

options.zh: 一致性
options.en: Consistency

options.zh: 延迟降低
options.en: Latency reduction

options.zh: 状态跟踪
options.en: State tracking

explanation.zh: 一致性要求类似控件表达稳定含义和行为；响应速度或部署环境是不同问题。
explanation.en: Consistency requires similar controls to retain meaning and behavior; response time or deployment environment is a separate issue.

prompt.zh: 医院服务界面采用合适领域风格且能在多种浏览器使用，分别体现什么？
prompt.en: A hospital-service interface fits its domain and works across browsers. Which goals are respectively shown?

options.zh: 兼容性；身份
options.en: Compatibility; identity

options.zh: 身份；兼容性
options.en: Identity; compatibility

options.zh: 一致性；运行效率
options.en: Consistency; runtime efficiency

options.zh: 可维护性；可读性
options.en: Maintainability; readability

explanation.zh: 领域一致性对应身份，运行环境适配对应兼容性；两者并非同一质量目标。
explanation.en: Domain fit concerns identity; environment adaptation concerns compatibility. They are distinct goals.

prompt.zh: 页面能够打开，但核心操作经常无法完成，哪种判断最合理？
prompt.en: A page opens but core actions often fail. Which judgment is most reasonable?

options.zh: 只要能打开页面，稳健性就与任务结果无关
options.en: Once a page opens, robustness is independent of task outcomes

options.zh: 只要颜色和布局一致，就可以忽略核心操作故障
options.en: Consistent colors/layout allow core-action failures to be ignored

options.zh: 尚不满足用户对稳健内容与功能的期待
options.en: It does not meet expectations of robust content and functions

options.zh: 只要用户能记住步骤，就证明所有功能可靠
options.en: Remembering the steps proves all functions are reliable

explanation.zh: 稳健性关注可依赖的内容和功能，不是单次页面加载成功或视觉装饰。
explanation.en: Robustness concerns dependable content and functions, not a single successful page load or decoration.

prompt.zh: 页面视觉精美，但用户找不到下一步入口，主要缺口是什么？
prompt.en: A page is visually polished but users cannot find the next step. What is the main gap?

options.zh: 视觉吸引力
options.en: Visual appeal

options.zh: 兼容性
options.en: Compatibility

options.zh: 可导航性
options.en: Navigability

options.zh: 可维护性
options.en: Maintainability

explanation.zh: 缺少清楚的路径属于导航问题；更多视觉细节不一定帮助用户找到操作。
explanation.en: Missing clear paths is a navigation problem; extra visual detail may not help users find actions.

prompt.zh: 新用户无法理解网站结构，也没有反馈或帮助，质量树中首先对应哪一维度？
prompt.en: New users cannot understand the site structure and lack feedback/help. Which quality-tree dimension is most directly implicated?

options.zh: 可维护性
options.en: Maintainability

options.zh: 运行效率
options.en: Runtime efficiency

options.zh: 可用性
options.en: Usability

options.zh: 功能性中的业务能力是否存在
options.en: Functionality as the presence of business capabilities

explanation.zh: 站点理解与反馈帮助是该图的可用性分支；维护成本或数量并不能直接解释问题。
explanation.en: Understandability and feedback/help belong to usability in the diagram; maintenance cost or function count alone does not explain the issue.

prompt.zh: 用户需要搜索公告但系统仅允许逐页翻看，首先应检查哪类质量能力？
prompt.en: Users need to search notices but can only browse page by page. Which quality capability should be examined first?

options.zh: 可维护性中的纠错难度
options.en: Maintainability as correction effort

options.zh: 运行效率中的页面生成时间
options.en: Runtime efficiency as page-generation time

options.zh: 搜索与检索等功能性能力
options.en: Functionality such as search and retrieval

options.zh: 可靠性中的输入恢复
options.en: Reliability as input recovery

explanation.zh: 缺失的是完成任务所需的检索能力，属于该图的功能性分支。
explanation.en: The missing retrieval capability is needed for the task and belongs to the functionality branch.

prompt.zh: 表单收到不合法输入时崩溃且无法恢复，最直接影响什么？
prompt.en: A form crashes on invalid input and cannot recover. What is most directly affected?

options.zh: 运行效率
options.en: Runtime efficiency

options.zh: 可靠性
options.en: Reliability

options.zh: 可维护性
options.en: Maintainability

options.zh: 功能性中的搜索覆盖
options.en: Functionality as search coverage

explanation.zh: 输入验证和恢复明确位于可靠性分支；其他体验维度不能代替错误处理。
explanation.en: Input validation and recovery are explicitly under reliability; other experience dimensions do not replace error handling.

prompt.zh: 页面生成明显缓慢，但用户已经知道操作步骤，质量树中首先对应哪项？
prompt.en: Page generation is slow although users understand the steps. Which quality-tree dimension is the primary issue?

options.zh: 易学性
options.en: Learnability

options.zh: 可维护性
options.en: Maintainability

options.zh: 运行效率
options.en: Runtime efficiency

options.zh: 功能性中的领域功能数量
options.en: Functionality as the number of domain functions

explanation.zh: 慢的是系统产生结果的速度，属于运行效率；用户理解步骤并不消除系统延迟。
explanation.en: The system is slow to produce results, a runtime-efficiency issue; understanding the steps does not remove latency.

prompt.zh: 小改动就需要重写大量代码，最直接暴露哪一质量缺口？
prompt.en: A small change requires rewriting large amounts of code. Which quality gap is most direct?

options.zh: 运行效率
options.en: Runtime efficiency

options.zh: 导航可理解性
options.en: Navigation understandability

options.zh: 跨浏览器兼容性
options.en: Cross-browser compatibility

options.zh: 可维护性
options.en: Maintainability

explanation.zh: 修改和纠错困难正是可维护性问题，不能用界面或浏览速度替代评估。
explanation.en: Difficulty changing or correcting code is a maintainability issue, distinct from interface appearance or browsing speed.

prompt.zh: 面包屑、清楚的可操作按钮和返回路径共同帮助回答什么？
prompt.en: Breadcrumbs, clear actionable buttons and a return path jointly answer what?

options.zh: 组件部署位置、数据库容量与服务器负载
options.en: Component deployment, database capacity and server load

options.zh: 当前位置、可执行动作与导航来路/去向
options.en: Current location, available actions and navigation history/destinations

options.zh: 未来路线图、开发预算与项目交付日期
options.en: Future roadmap, development budget and delivery date

options.zh: 团队角色、版本分支与代码合并方式
options.en: Team roles, version branches and merge strategy

explanation.zh: 这些元素把三个交互定位问题变成可见线索，帮助用户理解与行动。
explanation.en: These elements make the three orientation questions visible, supporting understanding and action.

prompt.zh: 上传资料完成后显示“查看文件”与“继续添加”，最体现哪个原则？
prompt.en: After an upload, offering “View file” and “Add another” most clearly illustrates which principle?

options.zh: 状态跟踪，恢复过去保存的进度
options.en: State tracking that restores previously saved progress

options.zh: 延迟降低，允许后台操作继续
options.en: Latency reduction that lets background work continue

options.zh: 预期
options.en: Anticipation

options.zh: 可读性，改善文字辨认
options.en: Readability that improves text recognition

explanation.zh: 完成后提供可能需要的下一步是预期原则；保存旧进度是状态跟踪，允许后台工作是延迟降低，改善文字辨认是可读性。
explanation.en: Offering likely next actions after completion is anticipation. Restoring earlier progress is state tracking, permitting background work is latency reduction, and improving text recognition is readability.

prompt.zh: 点击提交后毫无反应提示，用户不断重复点击，首先应改善什么？
prompt.en: After Submit, no feedback appears and users repeatedly click. What should be improved first?

options.zh: 仅改善可读性，把按钮文字变大
options.en: Improve only readability by enlarging button text

options.zh: 动作状态沟通
options.en: Action-status communication

options.zh: 仅改善身份，换用领域相关的图案
options.en: Improve only identity with domain-related imagery

options.zh: 仅改善兼容性，增加浏览器支持
options.en: Improve only compatibility by supporting more browsers

explanation.zh: 用户缺少状态信息，需要清楚反馈；更换外观或位置不能直接说明请求进展。
explanation.en: Users lack state information and need feedback; changing appearance or position does not explain request progress.

prompt.zh: 为了少写代码要求用户手工重复录入同一信息，违背哪个原则？
prompt.en: To save coding effort, users must re-enter the same information repeatedly. Which principle is violated?

options.zh: 运行效率中的图形生成速度
options.en: Graphics-generation speed within runtime efficiency

options.zh: 兼容性中的跨浏览器适配
options.en: Cross-browser adaptation within compatibility

options.zh: 可维护性中的代码修改难度
options.en: Code-modification effort within maintainability

options.zh: 以用户为中心的效率
options.en: User-centered efficiency

explanation.zh: 该原则把用户工作效率放在中心，开发便利不能成为增加用户重复劳动的充分理由。
explanation.en: The principle centers user efficiency; implementation convenience alone does not justify redundant user work.

prompt.zh: 哪种导航最符合受控自主性？
prompt.en: Which navigation best fits controlled autonomy?

options.zh: 为了保持一致，强迫用户始终按唯一顺序前进
options.en: Force one fixed sequence to maintain consistency

options.zh: 允许自由返回与切换，同时沿用一致导航约定
options.en: Allow returning/switching while preserving consistent conventions

options.zh: 允许自由移动，但每个页面独立定义相同控件的含义
options.en: Allow movement while each page defines identical controls differently

options.zh: 系统替用户决定所有下一步，以减少选择
options.en: Have the system decide every next step to reduce choices

explanation.zh: 自主移动与既定约定必须同时存在；任意变化或过度限制都偏离该原则。
explanation.en: Autonomous movement and established conventions must coexist; arbitrary changes or excessive restrictions violate the principle.

prompt.zh: 提供搜索直达以及按类别浏览两条找资料路径，最体现什么？
prompt.en: Providing direct search and category browsing for finding materials most clearly illustrates what?

options.zh: 状态跟踪
options.en: State tracking

options.zh: 灵活性
options.en: Flexibility

options.zh: 领域身份
options.en: Domain identity

options.zh: 运行效率
options.en: Runtime efficiency

explanation.zh: 直接任务和探索路径并存，照顾不同用户方式，体现界面灵活性。
explanation.en: Direct and exploratory routes accommodate different user styles, demonstrating flexibility.

prompt.zh: 填写施工问题表单时出现大量无关促销弹窗，应优先改善什么？
prompt.en: Many unrelated promotional popups interrupt a construction-concern form. What should be improved?

options.zh: 可移植性
options.en: Portability

options.zh: 状态跟踪
options.en: State tracking

options.zh: 任务聚焦
options.en: Task focus

options.zh: 跨浏览器兼容性
options.en: Cross-browser compatibility

explanation.zh: 无关内容干扰当前任务；聚焦需要保留相关帮助并减少分心项。
explanation.en: Irrelevant content distracts from the task; focus retains relevant help while reducing distractions.

prompt.zh: 大图加载时仍允许阅读文字和浏览其他内容，最符合哪个原则？
prompt.en: Allowing text reading and other browsing while a large image loads best fits which principle?

options.zh: 可读性
options.en: Readability

options.zh: 延迟降低
options.en: Latency reduction

options.zh: 状态跟踪
options.en: State tracking

options.zh: 领域身份
options.en: Domain identity

explanation.zh: 非阻塞处理降低等待对任务的影响；它应与状态沟通配合，而不是隐藏真实状态。
explanation.en: Nonblocking processing reduces the effect of waiting and should accompany status communication, not conceal it.

prompt.zh: 用户隔几周回来仍能迅速完成任务，说明哪项原则执行得较好？
prompt.en: Users return after several weeks and quickly complete tasks. Which principle is working well?

options.zh: 运行效率
options.en: Runtime efficiency

options.zh: 跨环境可移植性
options.en: Cross-environment portability

options.zh: 后台数据一致性
options.en: Backend data consistency

options.zh: 易学性
options.en: Learnability

explanation.zh: 易学性包括重学成本；保持可理解的交互有助于回访用户恢复操作。
explanation.en: Learnability includes relearning effort; understandable interactions help returning users resume work.

prompt.zh: 用“书签”表示以后再看的资料，何时是合适设计？
prompt.en: When is using a bookmark for materials to revisit appropriate?

options.zh: 开发者熟悉这个图标即可，无需考虑目标用户
options.en: Developer familiarity is sufficient regardless of target users

options.zh: 只要外观相似，操作意义可以与现实类比相反
options.en: Visual similarity is enough even if behavior contradicts the analogy

options.zh: 用户能理解该类比且行为与其含义相符
options.en: Users understand the analogy and behavior matches its meaning

options.zh: 隐喻越抽象越好，以迫使用户学习新规则
options.en: More abstract metaphors are better because they force new learning

explanation.zh: 恰当隐喻利用用户熟悉的类比帮助学习，如把收藏表达为书签。隐喻必须适合用户和应用，不能只因图标看起来熟悉就忽略其实际含义。
explanation.en: Appropriate metaphors use familiar analogies to support learning, such as bookmarks for saved items. A metaphor must fit the users and application rather than merely look familiar.

prompt.zh: 低对比度细小文本让用户难以读清，最直接应改善什么？
prompt.en: Low-contrast tiny text is hard to read. What should be improved most directly?

options.zh: 可读性
options.en: Readability

options.zh: 预期用户下一步
options.en: Anticipating the next user action

options.zh: 跟踪用户交互状态
options.en: Tracking user interaction state

options.zh: 多层架构的可维护性
options.en: Maintainability of layered architecture

explanation.zh: 低对比度和细小文字直接影响信息辨认，属于可读性；预期下一步、保存状态和代码维护各自解决不同问题。
explanation.en: Low contrast and tiny text directly affect recognition, hence readability. Anticipating actions, preserving state and maintaining code address different problems.

prompt.zh: 用户重新登录后恢复先前阅读位置和草稿，最体现哪个原则？
prompt.en: Restoring a user’s reading position and draft after login most clearly illustrates which principle?

options.zh: 跟踪并保存状态
options.en: Tracking and storing state

options.zh: 动作状态沟通，只显示本次请求的处理状态
options.en: Action-status communication showing only the current request state

options.zh: 延迟降低，只允许下载时继续操作
options.en: Latency reduction allowing work during downloads

options.zh: 兼容性，只适配不同浏览器
options.en: Compatibility adapting only to different browsers

explanation.zh: 保存状态让同一用户延续任务；带宽或视觉变化不能替代任务状态，跨账号合并也不是该原则。
explanation.en: Stored state provides continuity for the same user; bandwidth/appearance do not replace task state, and cross-account mixing is not the principle.

prompt.zh: 切换课程内容时保留清楚的导航与当前位置，主要支持什么？
prompt.en: Keeping clear navigation and current-location cues while switching course content primarily supports what?

options.zh: 延迟降低，主要缩短计算等待
options.en: Latency reduction, mainly reducing computation waiting

options.zh: 可见导航与稳定工作上下文
options.en: Visible navigation and a stable working context

options.zh: 可读性，主要改善文字辨认
options.en: Readability, mainly improving text recognition

options.zh: 领域身份，主要匹配应用主题
options.en: Domain identity, mainly matching the application domain

explanation.zh: 稳定线索降低迷路感，使内容变化不破坏用户的工作位置感。
explanation.en: Stable cues reduce disorientation so content changes do not destroy the user’s sense of working context.

reason.en: Section title slide.

overview.zh: 沿着浏览器请求、域名解析与服务器返回理解网页如何工作，再把 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 和框架放回前端、后端、全栈职责中。工具图仅整理课件列出的示例，不把宣传用语当作当前推荐排名。
overview.en: Trace browser requests, name resolution and server responses, then place HTML, CSS, JavaScript and frameworks within front-end, back-end and full-stack responsibilities. Tool figures are lecture examples, not current product rankings.

title.en: From an address to a page

title.zh: 客户端、服务器与网页文件

explanation.zh: 课件把网站解释为服务器上的网页与媒体文件，客户端用浏览器检索并加载它们。客户端是运行浏览器的设备，服务器提供资源；两个角色应按请求和提供职责理解。
explanation.en: The lecture explains a website as page/media files on a server that a client retrieves and loads through a browser. The client is the browser-running device and the server provides resources; distinguish the roles by requesting versus providing.

explanation.zh: 用户输入可读域名后，DNS 将域名解析成网络通信使用的 IP 地址，帮助浏览器找到相应服务器。DNS 解析地址，不负责把 HTML 排版成页面；课件的具体 IP 只是示例，不应作为实时地址使用。
explanation.en: After a human-readable domain is entered, DNS resolves it to an IP address used for network communication so the server can be located. DNS resolves names, not HTML layout; the slide’s particular IP is illustrative rather than a live address to rely on.

title.zh: 托管、资源返回与浏览器呈现
title.en: Hosting, resource delivery and browser rendering

explanation.zh: Web 托管服务器保存 HTML 和媒体资源，浏览器取得资源后呈现为人能阅读与操作的页面。域名解析、资源提供和呈现共同组成流程，各组件的职责不能混淆。
explanation.en: The hosting server stores HTML/media resources; the browser receives them and presents a human-readable, usable page. Name resolution, resource provision and rendering form a process with distinct responsibilities.

title.en: Front end, back end and full stack

explanation.zh: 前端负责用户看到和交互的部分，后端负责处理与服务，API 连接两者的交互；课件用餐厅前厅、厨房与服务员作类比。全栈工作跨越前后端，而不是只精通一种界面样式。
explanation.en: The front end handles what users see/interact with, the back end handles processing/services, and APIs mediate their interaction, illustrated by a restaurant’s dining area, kitchen and waiters. Full-stack work spans both ends rather than only visual styling.

explanation.zh: HTML 是标记语言，用元素描述页面结构。示例用 html 包含文档、head 放 title、body 放 h1 标题和 p 段落；浏览器显示内容结构，而不是把标签当普通正文。
explanation.en: HTML is a markup language describing document structure through elements. The example uses html around the document, head for title, and body for an h1 heading and p paragraph; the browser interprets the structure rather than treating tags as plain body text.

explanation.zh: CSS 控制排版、颜色和布局，为已有内容赋予视觉表现。改变样式可以保留同样的内容与语义结构，说明结构和呈现是可区分的职责。
explanation.en: CSS controls typography, colors and layout, giving content a visual presentation. Styling can change while content and semantic structure remain, illustrating separate structural and presentation responsibilities.

explanation.zh: JavaScript 是编程语言，为页面元素增加行为和交互，处理按钮、动画以及更复杂的动态功能。它与 HTML 的结构和 CSS 的样式协作，并非三者可以完全互相替代。
explanation.en: JavaScript is a programming language adding element behavior and interaction, including buttons, animations and more complex dynamic functions. It works with HTML structure and CSS styling; the three are not fully interchangeable.

title.en: Structure, style and behavior working together

explanation.zh: 课件将 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 分别归为标记、设计/样式和编程语言。分析一个页面时，先辨认内容结构，再看表现规则，最后看事件行为，避免把所有问题都归为“HTML 问题”。
explanation.en: The lecture classifies HTML, CSS and JavaScript as markup, design/styling and programming languages. Analyze content structure, presentation rules and event behavior separately instead of labelling every issue an HTML problem.

explanation.zh: 图中列出 JavaScript、Python、Java、PHP、Go、TypeScript、Ruby 和 Rust 等语言，说明 Web 生态有多种技术选择。图上的优势描述是课件引用的概括，不能据此断言某语言适合所有项目。
explanation.en: The figure lists JavaScript, Python, Java, PHP, Go, TypeScript, Ruby and Rust, illustrating multiple technology choices. Its advantage labels are cited generalizations, not proof that one language suits every project.

explanation.zh: 开发往往利用按文件和目录组织的预先编写代码，获得复用并保留灵活性。框架可减少重复劳动，但仍需理解结构、适配需求并测试整合效果。
explanation.en: Development often uses prewritten code organized in files and folders to gain reuse while retaining flexibility. Frameworks reduce repetition but still require structural understanding, requirements adaptation and integration testing.

explanation.zh: 示例图包括 React、Angular、Vue、Preact、jQuery、Svelte 和 Backbone。它把不同前端工具放在一起展示，学习重点是识别可复用的前端技术生态，而非把它们都视为同一种底层语言或当前排名。
explanation.en: The figure includes React, Angular, Vue, Preact, jQuery, Svelte and Backbone. It groups different front-end tools to illustrate reusable front-end technology, not one underlying language type or a current ranking.

relation.en: Clients use names to locate resources

relation.zh: 地址解析后请求资源并呈现
relation.en: After resolution, resources are requested and rendered

relation.zh: 前端职责落实到页面结构
relation.en: Front-end responsibilities become page structure

relation.zh: 结构由样式决定视觉表现
relation.en: Styles shape the structure’s appearance

relation.zh: 视觉控件由逻辑赋予交互
relation.en: Logic gives visual controls interaction

relation.zh: 三种基础职责需要协调
relation.en: Three foundational responsibilities must coordinate

relation.zh: 语言生态支持复用的软件工具
relation.en: Language ecosystems support reusable software tools

relation.zh: 前端工具是复用思路的具体例子
